inductive CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  CerberusHeapLang.Mem →
    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell → List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.addr_lo :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs →
    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      Iris.Std.get? m i = some c → σ.lastAddress ≤ c.addr
----
def CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.casesOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
    {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell} →
      {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq} →
        {motive : CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs → Sort u} →
          (t : CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs) →
            ((coh : CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ m) →
                (id_lt :
                    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                      Iris.Std.get? m i = some c → i < σ.nextAllocId) →
                  (fresh_alloc : ∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.allocations.get? id = none) →
                    (fresh_dead :
                        ∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
                      (addr_lo :
                          ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                            Iris.Std.get? m i = some c → σ.lastAddress ≤ c.addr) →
                        (plan :
                            CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds
                              { lastAddr := σ.lastAddress, nextId := σ.nextAllocId } reqs) →
                          (la_wf : σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64) → motive ⋯) →
              motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.coh :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs → CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ m
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.cohG :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq}
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs →
    CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb →
      CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb
        (Iris.Std.insert ∅ 0 { lastAddr := σ.lastAddress, nextId := σ.nextAllocId })
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.empty :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq),
  (∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.allocations.get? id = none) →
    (∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
      CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds { lastAddr := σ.lastAddress, nextId := σ.nextAllocId } reqs →
        σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64 → CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ ∅ reqs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.fresh_alloc :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs →
    ∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.allocations.get? id = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.fresh_dead :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs →
    ∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.id_lt :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs →
    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell), Iris.Std.get? m i = some c → i < σ.nextAllocId
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.la_wf :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs → σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh.mk :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq},
  CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ m →
    (∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell), Iris.Std.get? m i = some c → i < σ.nextAllocId) →
      (∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.allocations.get? id = none) →
        (∀ (id : Int), σ.nextAllocId ≤ id → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
          (∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
              Iris.Std.get? m i = some c → σ.lastAddress ≤ c.addr) →
            CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds { lastAddr := σ.lastAddress, nextId := σ.nextAllocId }
                reqs →
              σ.lastAddress ≤ 2 ^ 64 → CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh tds σ m reqs
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.labels_eq_of_proc :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {p : sym},
  M.proc = some p →
    M.labels =
      match
        fmapLookupBy (fun s1 s2 => Lem_Basic_classes.ordCompare s1 s2) (M.resolveProc p)
          M.runState.labeled with
      | some Q => Q
      | none => fmapEmpty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.labels_lookup_some :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {l : sym}
  {pc : List (sym × core_base_type) × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some pc →
    ∃ p, M.proc = some p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt M.runState (M.resolveProc p) M.labels

  generic_file Unit core_run_annotation →
    Fmap sym sym →
      Nat →
        Option Nat →

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.inj :
∀ {tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {extern : Fmap sym sym} {tid : Nat}
  {parent : Option Nat} {stack : stack core_run_annotation} {errno : CerbMem.PointerValue}
  {proc : Option sym} {execLoc : exec_location} {currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {runState : core_run_state} {tagDefs_1 : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {file_1 : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {extern_1 : Fmap sym sym} {tid_1 : Nat}
  {parent_1 : Option Nat} {stack_1 : _root_.stack core_run_annotation}
  {errno_1 : CerbMem.PointerValue} {proc_1 : Option sym} {execLoc_1 : exec_location}
  {currentLoc_1 : CerbLocation.Loc} {runState_1 : core_run_state},
  { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid, parent := parent,
        stack := stack, errno := errno, proc := proc, execLoc := execLoc, currentLoc := currentLoc,
        runState := runState } =
      { tagDefs := tagDefs_1, file := file_1, extern := extern_1, tid := tid_1, parent := parent_1,
        stack := stack_1, errno := errno_1, proc := proc_1, execLoc := execLoc_1,
        currentLoc := currentLoc_1, runState := runState_1 } →
    tagDefs = tagDefs_1 ∧
      file = file_1 ∧
        extern = extern_1 ∧
          tid = tid_1 ∧
            parent = parent_1 ∧
              stack = stack_1 ∧
                errno = errno_1 ∧
                  proc = proc_1 ∧
                    execLoc = execLoc_1 ∧ currentLoc = currentLoc_1 ∧ runState = runState_1

∀ (tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))

  (parent : Option Nat) (stack : stack core_run_annotation) (errno : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (proc : Option sym) (execLoc : exec_location) (currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (runState : core_run_state) (tagDefs_1 : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (file_1 : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (extern_1 : Fmap sym sym) (tid_1 : Nat)
  (parent_1 : Option Nat) (stack_1 : _root_.stack core_run_annotation)
  (errno_1 : CerbMem.PointerValue) (proc_1 : Option sym) (execLoc_1 : exec_location)
  (currentLoc_1 : CerbLocation.Loc) (runState_1 : core_run_state),
  ({ tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid, parent := parent,
        stack := stack, errno := errno, proc := proc, execLoc := execLoc, currentLoc := currentLoc,
        runState := runState } =
      { tagDefs := tagDefs_1, file := file_1, extern := extern_1, tid := tid_1, parent := parent_1,
        stack := stack_1, errno := errno_1, proc := proc_1, execLoc := execLoc_1,

      file = file_1 ∧
        extern = extern_1 ∧
          tid = tid_1 ∧
            parent = parent_1 ∧
              stack = stack_1 ∧
                errno = errno_1 ∧
                  proc = proc_1 ∧
                    execLoc = execLoc_1 ∧ currentLoc = currentLoc_1 ∧ runState = runState_1)

def CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} →
    {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} →
      {extern : Fmap sym sym} →
        {tid : Nat} →
          {parent : Option Nat} →
            {stack : stack core_run_annotation} →
              {errno : CerbMem.PointerValue} →
                {proc : Option sym} →
                  {execLoc : exec_location} →
                    {currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc} →
                      {runState : core_run_state} →
                        {tagDefs' : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} →
                          {file' : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} →
                            {extern' : Fmap sym sym} →
                              {tid' : Nat} →
                                {parent' : Option Nat} →
                                  {stack' : _root_.stack core_run_annotation} →
                                    {errno' : CerbMem.PointerValue} →
                                      {proc' : Option sym} →
                                        {execLoc' : exec_location} →
                                          {currentLoc' : CerbLocation.Loc} →
                                            {runState' : core_run_state} →
                                              { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern,
                                                    tid := tid, parent := parent, stack := stack,
                                                    errno := errno, proc := proc,
                                                    execLoc := execLoc, currentLoc := currentLoc,
                                                    runState := runState } =
                                                  { tagDefs := tagDefs', file := file',
                                                    extern := extern', tid := tid',
                                                    parent := parent', stack := stack',
                                                    errno := errno', proc := proc',
                                                    execLoc := execLoc', currentLoc := currentLoc',
                                                    runState := runState' } →
                                                (tagDefs = tagDefs' →
                                                    file = file' →
                                                      extern = extern' →
                                                        tid = tid' →
                                                          parent = parent' →
                                                            stack = stack' →
                                                              errno = errno' →
                                                                proc = proc' →
                                                                  execLoc = execLoc' →
                                                                    currentLoc = currentLoc' →
                                                                      runState = runState' → P) →
                                                  P
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx.mk.sizeOf_spec :
∀ (tagDefs : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition))
  (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (extern : Fmap sym sym) (tid : Nat)
  (parent : Option Nat) (stack : stack core_run_annotation) (errno : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (proc : Option sym) (execLoc : exec_location) (currentLoc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (runState : core_run_state),
  sizeOf
      { tagDefs := tagDefs, file := file, extern := extern, tid := tid, parent := parent,
        stack := stack, errno := errno, proc := proc, execLoc := execLoc, currentLoc := currentLoc,
        runState := runState } =
    1 + sizeOf tagDefs + sizeOf file + sizeOf extern + sizeOf tid + sizeOf parent + sizeOf stack +
              sizeOf errno +
            sizeOf proc +
          sizeOf execLoc +
        sizeOf currentLoc +
      sizeOf runState
----

inductive CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell →
    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell →
      CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.byte_all :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb →
    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
        ∀ (j : Nat), j < c.bytes.length → Iris.Std.get? mb (c.addr + ↑j) = c.bytes[j]?
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.byte_cov :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb →
    ∀ (k : Int) (b : CerbMem.AbsByte),
      Iris.Std.get? mb k = some b →
        ∃ i c,
          Iris.Std.get? m i = some c ∧
            c.addr ≤ k ∧
              k < c.addr + ↑c.bytes.length ∧
                b = c.bytes[(k - c.addr).toNat]?.getD CerberusHeapLang.undefByte
----
def CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.casesOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell} →
    {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} →
        {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb → Sort u} →
          (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb) →
            ((meta_sub :
                  ∀ (i : Int) (mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell),
                    Iris.Std.get? mm i = some mc →
                      ∃ c, Iris.Std.get? m i = some c ∧ mc = CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c) →
                (meta_all :
                    ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                      Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
                        Iris.Std.get? mm i = some (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c)) →
                  (byte_cov :
                      ∀ (k : Int) (b : CerbMem.AbsByte),
                        Iris.Std.get? mb k = some b →
                          ∃ i c,
                            Iris.Std.get? m i = some c ∧
                              c.addr ≤ k ∧
                                k < c.addr + ↑c.bytes.length ∧
                                  b =
                                    c.bytes[(k - c.addr).toNat]?.getD CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) →
                    (byte_all :
                        ∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
                          Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
                            ∀ (j : Nat),
                              j < c.bytes.length → Iris.Std.get? mb (c.addr + ↑j) = c.bytes[j]?) →
                      motive ⋯) →
              motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf.cohG :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell}

            Iris.Std.get? m i = some c →
              ∀ (j : Nat), j < c.bytes.length → Iris.Std.get? mb (c.addr + ↑j) = c.bytes[j]?) →
          CerberusHeapLang.MetaByteOf tds m mm mb

  { addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size } = { addr := addr_1, ty := ty_1, size := size_1 } →
    addr = addr_1 ∧ ty = ty_1 ∧ size = size_1

  ({ addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size } = { addr := addr_1, ty := ty_1, size := size_1 }) =
    (addr = addr_1 ∧ ty = ty_1 ∧ size = size_1)

def CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell.mk.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {addr : Int} →
    {ty : ctype} →
      {size : Nat} →
        {addr' : Int} →
          {ty' : ctype} →
            {size' : Nat} →
              { addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size } =
                  { addr := addr', ty := ty', size := size' } →
                (addr = addr' → ty = ty' → size = size' → P) → P

∀ (addr : Int) (ty : ctype) (size : Nat),
  sizeOf { addr := addr, ty := ty, size := size } = 1 + sizeOf addr + sizeOf ty + sizeOf size

theorem CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.alloc :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc →
    ∃ al,
      σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
        al.base = mc.addr ∧
          al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
            al.ty = some mc.ty ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable
----
def CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.casesOn :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {id : Int} →
    {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc) →
          ((dead : σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
              (alloc :
                  ∃ al,
                    σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
                      al.base = mc.addr ∧
                        al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
                          al.ty = some mc.ty ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable) →
                (nonAtomic : CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy mc.ty = false) → motive ⋯) →
            motive t

  CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false

ctor CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.mk :
∀ {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {id : Int} {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell},
  σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false →
    (∃ al,
        σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
          al.base = mc.addr ∧
            al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
              al.ty = some mc.ty ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable) →
      CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy mc.ty = false → CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc

def CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh.recOn :
{σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
  {id : Int} →
    {mc : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.MetaCoh σ id mc) →
          ((dead : σ.deadAllocations.contains id = false) →
              (alloc :
                  ∃ al,
                    σ.allocations.get? id = some al ∧
                      al.base = mc.addr ∧
                        al.size = ↑mc.size ∧
                          al.ty = some mc.ty ∧ al.isReadonly = CerbMem.ReadonlyStatus.IsWritable) →
                (nonAtomic : CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy mc.ty = false) → motive ⋯) →
            motive t

theorem CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.inj :
∀ {id v : Int} {l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree} {id_1 v_1 : Int}
  {l_1 r_1 : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree},
  CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r = CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id_1 v_1 l_1 r_1 →
    id = id_1 ∧ v = v_1 ∧ l = l_1 ∧ r = r_1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.injEq :
∀ (id v : Int) (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (id_1 v_1 : Int)
  (l_1 r_1 : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r = CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id_1 v_1 l_1 r_1) =
    (id = id_1 ∧ v = v_1 ∧ l = l_1 ∧ r = r_1)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {id v : Int} →
    {l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree} →
      {id' v' : Int} →
        {l' r' : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree} →
          CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r = CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id' v' l' r' →
            (id = id' → v = v' → l = l' → r = r' → P) → P
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node.sizeOf_spec :
∀ (id v : Int) (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  sizeOf (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r) = 1 + sizeOf id + sizeOf v + sizeOf l + sizeOf r

def CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound.casesOn :

  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c),
  (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config)
      (a :
        ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
          ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'')
      (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c'), motive ⋯) →
    (∀
        (a :
          ∀ (dst : driver_state),

              ∃ rsk m,
                step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                    (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                  [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m]),

      (∀ (a : M.proc = none)
          (a_1 :
            ∀ (dst : driver_state),
              M.Embeds dst c →
                ∃ s m,
                  step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                      (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                    [Step_with_runstate2 (RSK_eval s) m]),
          motive ⋯) →
        motive t

∀ {V : Type} (m₁ m₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF V) (k : Int),

def CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap → CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor → List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits.eq_def :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor)
  (x : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq),
  CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds c x =
    match x with
    | [] => True
    | r :: rs =>
      match CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor tds c r with
      | some c' => CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds c' rs
      | none => False
----

  CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds c (rs ++ rs') → CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds c rs

  CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds c (r :: rs) ↔

def CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
        CerbMem.PointerValue → List CerbMem.AbsByte → List CerbMem.AbsByte → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_create :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int)
  (rest : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq) (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  (CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs
        ({ align := alignN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy } :: rest) ∗
      ∀ p,
        CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p
              CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.undefField
              CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.undefField ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs rest ∗
              ⌜0 < CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p ∧ CerberusHeapLang.addrOf p < 2 ^ 64⌝ -∗
          Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vobject (OVpointer p))) ρ) ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M Ls Ψ
      (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN)
        CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy pref)
      ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (xb yb : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField tds p xb yb ⊣⊢
    ∃ id a,
      ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a⌝ ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy 0
            (Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)) (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy xb ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.pointsToView tds id a CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy 8
            (Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)) (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy yb
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_load_x :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF}
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue)
  (mo : memory_order) (xb yb : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (ad : Int),
      CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm ad CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy xb =
        mv) →
    CerberusHeapLang.loadTrapV CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy mv = false →
      (CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p xb yb ∗
          ∀ fp,
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p xb yb -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] (valueFromMemValue mv).snd) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M Ls Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy p mo) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_load_y :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}

      CerbMem.reconstructValue M.tagDefs lum fpm ad CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy yb =
        mv) →

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_of_cell :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  p ↦c[tds]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy ;
      List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.objTy)
        CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField tds p CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.undefField
      CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.undefField

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField_store_x :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]

  {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy)) cv =
      some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt M.tagDefs CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy mv →
      (CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p xb yb ∗
          ∀ fp,
            CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.twoField M.tagDefs p
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes M.tagDefs [] mv).snd yb -∗
              Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp] Vunit) ρ) ⊢
        CerberusHeapLang.wps M Ls Ψ
          (CerberusHeapLang.storeExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.ReadinessSmoke.fieldTy p cv mo) ρ

def CerberusHeapLang.Redex.casesOn :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Redex a → Prop}
  {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Redex a),
  (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
      motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
          {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
        (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
            motive
              (generic_expr.Expr []
                (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2))
              ⋯) →
          (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
              motive
                (generic_expr.Expr []
                  (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2))
                ⋯) →
            (∀ {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                (hirr :
                  is_irreducible
                      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) =
                    false),
                motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b))))
                  ⋯) →
              (∀ (sb : sym × core_base_type)
                  (ps :
                    List
                      (sym ×
                        (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                          generic_pexpr Unit sym))
                  (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                (∀ (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
                      (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)),
                      motive (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex pe pats) ⋯) →
                    (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex pe) ⋯) →
                        (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                            {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                            (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                          (∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                              {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                              motive
                                (generic_expr.Expr []
                                  (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                ⋯) →
                            (∀ (mop : memop) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop pes) ⋯) →
                              (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                                  {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                                  (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none),
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo) ⋯) →
                                (∀ {pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                    {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                    motive
                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                        (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                      ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                      motive
                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                          (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                            e2))
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                        {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                                        {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                        motive
                                          (generic_expr.Expr []
                                            (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
                                              e2))
                                          ⋯) →
                                      motive a t

rec CerberusHeapLang.Redex.rec :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Redex a → Prop},
  (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
      motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
          {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
        (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
            motive
              (generic_expr.Expr []
                (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2))
              ⋯) →
          (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
              motive
                (generic_expr.Expr []
                  (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2))
                ⋯) →
            (∀ {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                (hirr :
                  is_irreducible
                      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) =
                    false),
                motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b))))
                  ⋯) →
              (∀ (sb : sym × core_base_type)
                  (ps :
                    List
                      (sym ×
                        (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                          generic_pexpr Unit sym))
                  (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                (∀ (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
                      (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)),
                      motive (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex pe pats) ⋯) →
                    (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex pe) ⋯) →
                        (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                            {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                            (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                          (∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                              {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                              motive
                                (generic_expr.Expr []
                                  (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                ⋯) →
                            (∀ (mop : memop) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop pes) ⋯) →
                              (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                                  {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                                  (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none),
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo) ⋯) →
                                (∀ {pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                    {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                    motive
                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                        (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                      ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                      motive
                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                          (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                            e2))
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                        {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                                        {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                        motive
                                          (generic_expr.Expr []
                                            (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
                                              e2))
                                          ⋯) →
                                      ∀ {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                        (t : CerberusHeapLang.Redex a), motive a t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.Redex.recOn :
∀ {motive : (a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → CerberusHeapLang.Redex a → Prop}
  {a : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} (t : CerberusHeapLang.Redex a),
  (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype}
      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order},
      motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeRedex loc ann lk ty pv cv mo) ⋯) →
    (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order}, motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadRedex loc ann ty pv mo) ⋯) →
      (∀ {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue}
          {ty : ctype} {pref : prefix0},
          motive (CerberusHeapLang.createRedex loc ann align ty pref) ⋯) →
        (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
            motive
              (generic_expr.Expr []
                (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2))
              ⋯) →
          (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
              motive
                (generic_expr.Expr []
                  (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2))
                ⋯) →
            (∀ {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation} {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                (hirr :
                  is_irreducible
                      (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b)))) =
                    false),
                motive (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds2 b))))
                  ⋯) →
              (∀ (sb : sym × core_base_type)
                  (ps :
                    List
                      (sym ×
                        (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                          generic_pexpr Unit sym))
                  (body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.saveRedex sb ps body) ⋯) →
                (∀ (g : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
                    motive (CerberusHeapLang.ifRedex g e2 e3) ⋯) →
                  (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym)
                      (pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)),
                      motive (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex pe pats) ⋯) →
                    (∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (l : sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                        motive (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none),
                          motive (CerberusHeapLang.pureRedex pe) ⋯) →
                        (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                            {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                            (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none),
                            motive (CerberusHeapLang.loadOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 mo) ⋯) →
                          (∀ {pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                              {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                              motive
                                (generic_expr.Expr []
                                  (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                ⋯) →
                            (∀ (mop : memop) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
                                motive (CerberusHeapLang.memopRedex mop pes) ⋯) →
                              (∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation) (ty : ctype)
                                  {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} (mo : memory_order)
                                  (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none),
                                  motive (CerberusHeapLang.storeOpRedex loc ann ty pe2 pe3 mo) ⋯) →
                                (∀ {pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                    {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal}
                                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                    motive
                                      (generic_expr.Expr []
                                        (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal w) e2))
                                      ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                      motive
                                        (generic_expr.Expr []
                                          (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                            e2))
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ {pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
                                        {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                                        {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr},
                                        motive
                                          (generic_expr.Expr []
                                            (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
                                              e2))
                                          ⋯) →
                                      motive a t

inductive CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx → CerberusHeapLang.Config → Prop
----
def CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c),
  (∀ (v : value) (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
      (a_1 :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_done2 v]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value)
        (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
        (a_1 :
          CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c
            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v), c.snd.fst, c.snd.snd)),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (a : CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
          (a_1 :
            ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
              CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'' ↔ CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c''),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
            (a_1 :
              ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
            (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c), motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
              (a_1 :
                ∀
                  (c' :
                    CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                  ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
              (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c), motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.open_ :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none →
    (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c') →
      CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c → CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c
----
rec CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.rec :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c → Prop},
  (∀ (v : value) (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
      (a_1 :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_done2 v]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value)
        (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
        (a_1 :
          CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c
            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v), c.snd.fst, c.snd.snd)),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (a : CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
          (a_1 :
            ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
              CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'' ↔ CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c''),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
            (a_1 :
              ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
            (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c), motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
              (a_1 :
                ∀
                  (c' :
                    CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                  ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
              (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c), motive ⋯) →
            ∀ (t : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c), motive t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.recOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c),
  (∀ (v : value) (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
      (a_1 :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_done2 v]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value)
        (a : c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v))
        (a_1 :
          CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c
            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v), c.snd.fst, c.snd.snd)),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config) (a : CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
          (a_1 :
            ∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
              CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'' ↔ CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c''),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
            (a_1 :
              ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
            (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c), motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (a : CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none)
              (a_1 :
                ∀
                  (c' :
                    CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                  ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c')
              (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.OpenRound M c), motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.refused :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  CerberusHeapLang.toVal c.fst = none →
    (∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c') →
      CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c → CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (c' : CerberusHeapLang.Config),
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c' →
    (∀ (c'' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'' ↔ CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c c'') →
      CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.value_annot :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (ds : List dyn_annotation)
  (v : value),
  c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v) →
    CerberusHeapLang.CerberusRound M c
        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v), c.snd.fst, c.snd.snd) →
      CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c

ctor CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.value_done :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (v : value),
  c.fst = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) →

        M.Embeds dst c →
          step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
              (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
            [Step_done2 v]) →
      CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass M c

theorem CerberusHeapLang.RoundClass.value_not_step :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} {w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal},

    ∀ (c' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      ¬CerberusHeapLang.Step M c c'

def CerberusHeapLang.RoundComplete :

----
def CerberusHeapLang.Sat :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Sat.mono :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {m m' : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap},
  CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ m → m' ⊆ m → CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ m'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Sat.union_left :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {Q R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap},
  CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R) → CerberusHeapLang.Sat tds σ Q
----
def CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain :
CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell →
  CerbMem.PointerValue → List (Int × Int) → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain.footprint :
∀ (ns : List (Int × Int)) (m : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell)
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain m p ns →
    ∀ (k : Int), (Iris.Std.get? m k).isSome = true ↔ k ∈ List.map Prod.fst ns
----
def CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree :
CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → CerbMem.PointerValue → CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree.footprint :
∀ (t : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (m : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree m p t → ∀ (k : Int), (Iris.Std.get? m k).isSome = true ↔ k ∈ t.ids
----
def CerberusHeapLang.SemTripleU :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
  CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack →
    CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr →
      CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → (value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop) → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SemTripleU_iff_Mem :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
  (P : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop),
  CerberusHeapLang.SemTripleU M ρ e P post ↔
    CerberusHeapLang.MemTripleU M ρ e P fun R v σ' =>
      ∃ Q,
        post v Q ∧
          Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.Sat M.tagDefs σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)
----
inductive CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx → CerberusHeapLang.Config → Prop
----
def CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.casesOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config}
  {motive : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c → Prop} (t : CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c),
  (∀ (msg : String)
      (a :
        ∀ (dst : driver_state),
          M.Embeds dst c →
            step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_error2 msg]),
      motive ⋯) →
    (∀ (r : kill_reason driver_error)
        (a :
          ∀ (dst : driver_state),
            M.Embeds dst c →
              ∃ s dst',
                step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                      (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                    [s] ∧
                  can_advance s = true ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst =
                      (NDkilled r, dst')),
        motive ⋯) →
      (∀
          (a :
            ∀ (dst : driver_state),
              M.Embeds dst c →
                ∃ s,
                  step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                        (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                      [s] ∧
                    can_advance s = true ∧
                      2 ≤ (CerbND.runND (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst).length),
          motive ⋯) →
        (∀
            (a :
              ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                M.Embeds dst c →
                  ∃ rsk m d inst step_m k msg,
                    step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                          (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                        [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m] ∧
                      m = stExceptUndef_bind step_m k ∧
                        step_m dst.core_run_state0 = failwithI msg dst.core_run_state0),
            motive ⋯) →
          (∀ (msg : String)
              (a :
                ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                  M.Embeds dst c →
                    ∃ s th' evs,
                      step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                            (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                          [Step_tau2 s TSK_Misc th'] ∧
                        th'.env = failwithI msg :: evs),
              motive ⋯) →
            (∀ (msg : String)
                (a :
                  ∀ (dst : driver_state),
                    M.Embeds dst c →
                      ∃ loc mop cvals uw k g,
                        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                              (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
                            [Step_memop_request2 loc mop cvals M.tid uw k] ∧
                          perform_memop_request2 M.tagDefs loc mop cvals M.tid k =
                            nd_bind (failwithI msg) g),
                motive ⋯) →
              motive t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.error :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (msg : String),
  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →
        step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
            (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
          [Step_error2 msg]) →
    CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.fork :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →
        ∃ s,
          step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [s] ∧
            can_advance s = true ∧ 2 ≤ (CerbND.runND (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst).length) →
    CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.killed :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (r : kill_reason driver_error),
  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →
        ∃ s dst',
          step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [s] ∧
            can_advance s = true ∧
              CerberusHeapLang.runOne (advance_step M.tagDefs M.tid s) dst = (NDkilled r, dst')) →
    CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.panic :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config},
  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →
        ∃ rsk m d inst step_m k msg,
          step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_with_runstate2 rsk m] ∧
            m = stExceptUndef_bind step_m k ∧
              step_m dst.core_run_state0 = failwithI msg dst.core_run_state0) →
    CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.panic_env :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (msg : String),
  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →
        ∃ s th' evs,
          step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_tau2 s TSK_Misc th'] ∧
            th'.env = failwithI msg :: evs) →
    CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal.panic_memop :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {c : CerberusHeapLang.Config} (msg : String),
  (∀ (dst : driver_state),
      M.Embeds dst c →
        ∃ loc mop cvals uw k g,
          step_ctx M.tagDefs dst.layout_state dst.core_file dst.core_extern M.tid
                (M.parent, M.thread c.fst c.snd.fst) =
              [Step_memop_request2 loc mop cvals M.tid uw k] ∧
            perform_memop_request2 M.tagDefs loc mop cvals M.tid k = nd_bind (failwithI msg) g) →
    CerberusHeapLang.ShippedRefusal M c

theorem CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell.mk.inj :
∀ {addr : Int} {ty : ctype} {bytes : List CerbMem.AbsByte} {addr_1 : Int} {ty_1 : ctype}
  {bytes_1 : List CerbMem.AbsByte},
  { addr := addr, ty := ty, bytes := bytes } = { addr := addr_1, ty := ty_1, bytes := bytes_1 } →
    addr = addr_1 ∧ ty = ty_1 ∧ bytes = bytes_1
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell.mk.injEq :
∀ (addr : Int) (ty : ctype) (bytes : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (addr_1 : Int) (ty_1 : ctype)
  (bytes_1 : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  ({ addr := addr, ty := ty, bytes := bytes } = { addr := addr_1, ty := ty_1, bytes := bytes_1 }) =
    (addr = addr_1 ∧ ty = ty_1 ∧ bytes = bytes_1)
----
def CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell.mk.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {addr : Int} →
    {ty : ctype} →
      {bytes : List CerbMem.AbsByte} →
        {addr' : Int} →
          {ty' : ctype} →
            {bytes' : List CerbMem.AbsByte} →
              { addr := addr, ty := ty, bytes := bytes } =
                  { addr := addr', ty := ty', bytes := bytes' } →
                (addr = addr' → ty = ty' → bytes = bytes' → P) → P
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell.mk.sizeOf_spec :
∀ (addr : Int) (ty : ctype) (bytes : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  sizeOf { addr := addr, ty := ty, bytes := bytes } = 1 + sizeOf addr + sizeOf ty + sizeOf bytes
----
def CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell.noConfusion :
{P : Sort u} →
  {t t' : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell} → t = t' → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell.noConfusionType P t t'

            CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF

def CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS.mk.noConfusion :
{hlc : outParam Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    {P : Sort u} →
      {invGS : Iris.InvGS_gen hlc GF} →
        {byteGS : Iris.genHeapGS Int CerbMem.AbsByte GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
          {metaGS : Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
            {cursorGS :
                Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
              {invGS' : Iris.InvGS_gen hlc GF} →
                {byteGS' : Iris.genHeapGS Int CerbMem.AbsByte GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                  {metaGS' :
                      Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                    {cursorGS' :
                        Iris.genHeapGS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF
                          CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                      { invGS := invGS, byteGS := byteGS, metaGS := metaGS, cursorGS := cursorGS } =
                          { invGS := invGS', byteGS := byteGS', metaGS := metaGS',
                            cursorGS := cursorGS' } →
                        (invGS ≍ invGS' →
                            byteGS ≍ byteGS' → metaGS ≍ metaGS' → cursorGS ≍ cursorGS' → P) →
                          P

{P : Sort u} →
  {hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
    {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
      {t : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF} →
        {hlc' : Iris.HasLC} →
          {GF' : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
            {t' : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc' GF'} →
              hlc = hlc' → GF = GF' → t ≍ t' → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS.noConfusionType P t t'

                    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF) →
                motive
                  { toInvGpreS := toInvGpreS, byte_pre := byte_pre, meta_pre := meta_pre,
                    cursor_pre := cursor_pre }) →
        motive t

        Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF →
          CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF

def CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS.mk.noConfusion :
{GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
  {P : Sort u} →
    {toInvGpreS : Iris.InvGpreS GF} →
      {byte_pre : Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerbMem.AbsByte GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
        {meta_pre : Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
          {cursor_pre :
              Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
            {toInvGpreS' : Iris.InvGpreS GF} →
              {byte_pre' : Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerbMem.AbsByte GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                {meta_pre' :
                    Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell GF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                  {cursor_pre' :
                      Iris.genHeapPreS Int CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor GF
                        CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF} →
                    { toInvGpreS := toInvGpreS, byte_pre := byte_pre, meta_pre := meta_pre,
                          cursor_pre := cursor_pre } =
                        { toInvGpreS := toInvGpreS', byte_pre := byte_pre', meta_pre := meta_pre',
                          cursor_pre := cursor_pre' } →
                      (toInvGpreS ≍ toInvGpreS' →
                          byte_pre ≍ byte_pre' →
                            meta_pre ≍ meta_pre' → cursor_pre ≍ cursor_pre' → P) →
                        P
----

      {GF' : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
        {t' : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF'} →
          GF = GF' → t ≍ t' → CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS.noConfusionType P t t'

inductive CerberusHeapLang.Step :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
  CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem →
    CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_ctx :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation}
  {b b' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (b, ρ, σ) (b', ρ', σ') →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b), ρ, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b'), ρ', σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation}
  {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b), ρ, σ) out →
    (CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = none ∧
          ∃ b' ρ' σ',
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M (b, ρ, σ) (b', ρ', σ') ∧
              out = (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b'), ρ', σ')) ∨
      (∃ a2 ds2 c,
          b = generic_expr.Expr a2 (Eannot ds2 c) ∧
            out = (generic_expr.Expr (a ++ a2) (Eannot (ds ++ ds2) c), ρ, σ)) ∨
        ∃ l pes params cont vs ev0 evs,
          CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = some (l, pes) ∧
              ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
                    out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.annot_merge :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a1 a2 : List annot} {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation}
  {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a1 (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr a2 (Eannot ds2 b))), ρ, σ)
    (generic_expr.Expr (a1 ++ a2) (Eannot (ds1 ++ ds2) b), ρ, σ)
----

  {motive :
      (a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem) →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1 → Prop} →
    {a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem} →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1 → Prop

  (hnj : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = none) (a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false)
