                                            (core_base_type ×
                                                Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                              generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                      {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value}
                                      {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
                                      {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                      (hvals :
                                        valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                                          some cvals),
                                      motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ev0 :: evs, σ)
                                        (body,
                                          CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals (ev0 :: evs), σ)
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
                                        {ps :
                                          List
                                            (sym ×
                                              (core_base_type ×
                                                  Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                                generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                        {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value}
                                        {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                        (hnv :
                                          valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                                            none)
                                        (hvals :
                                          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                                            some cvals),
                                        motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, σ)
                                          (generic_expr.Expr a
                                              (Esave sb
                                                (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals)
                                                body),
                                            ρ, σ)
                                          ⋯) →
                                      (∀ {a : List annot} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                          {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                          (hg :
                                            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ g =
                                              some Vtrue),
                                          motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3), ρ, σ)
                                            (e2, ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {a : List annot} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                            {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                            {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                            {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                            (hg :
                                              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ g =
                                                some Vfalse),
                                            motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3), ρ, σ)
                                              (e3, ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {a : List annot} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                              {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)}
                                              {cval : value} {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                              {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                              {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                              (hv : valueFromPexpr pe = some cval)
                                              (hsel :
                                                select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e'),
                                              motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats), ρ, σ)
                                                (e', ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {a pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
                                                {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                                                motive
                                                  (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                      (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                          (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                                        e2),
                                                    ev0 :: evs, σ)
                                                  (e2,
                                                    update_env (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) v
                                                      (ev0 :: evs),
                                                    σ)
                                                  ⋯) →
                                              (∀ {a : List annot} {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                  {pv1 pv2 : CerbMem.PointerValue} {b : Bool}
                                                  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                  (h1 :
                                                    valueFromPexpr pe1 =
                                                      some (Vobject (OVpointer pv1)))
                                                  (h2 :
                                                    valueFromPexpr pe2 =
                                                      some (Vobject (OVpointer pv2)))
                                                  (hmem :
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                                                        (CerbMem.eqPtrval default pv1 pv2) σ =
                                                      some (b, σ')),
                                                  motive
                                                    (generic_expr.Expr a (Ememop PtrEq [pe1, pe2]),
                                                      ρ, σ)
                                                    (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                        (Epure
                                                          (Pexpr [] ()
                                                            (PEval
                                                              (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue b)))),
                                                      ρ, σ')
                                                    ⋯) →
                                                (∀ {a : List annot} {mop : memop}
                                                    {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                    {v1 v2 : value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                    {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                    (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                                    (hv1 :
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern
                                                          ρ pe1 =
                                                        some v1)
                                                    (hv2 :
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern
                                                          ρ pe2 =
                                                        some v2),
                                                    motive
                                                      (generic_expr.Expr a (Ememop mop [pe1, pe2]),
                                                        ρ, σ)
                                                      (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                          (Ememop mop
                                                            [Pexpr [] () (PEval v1),
                                                              Pexpr [] () (PEval v2)]),
                                                        ρ, σ)
                                                      ⋯) →
                                                  (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
                                                      {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool}
                                                      {ty : ctype}
                                                      {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
                                                      {mo : memory_order}
                                                      {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                      {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                      (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none)
                                                      (hv2 :
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                            M.extern ρ pe2 =
                                                          some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))
                                                      (hv3 :
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                            M.extern ρ pe3 =
                                                          some cv),
                                                      motive
                                                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                            (Eaction
                                                              (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                (Action loc ann
                                                                  (Store0 lk
                                                                    (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                      (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                                                                    pe2 pe3 mo)))),
                                                          ρ, σ)
                                                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                            (Eaction
                                                              (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                (Action loc ann
                                                                  (Store0 lk
                                                                    (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                      (PEval (Vctype ty)))

                                                                      (PEval
                                                                        (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))
                                                                    (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv)) mo)))),
                                                          ρ, σ)
                                                        ⋯) →
                                                    ∀
                                                      {a a_1 :
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr ×
                                                          CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack ×
                                                            CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                      (t : CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1),
                                                      motive a a_1 t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.Step.recOn :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx}
  {motive :
    (a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem) →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1 → Prop}
  {a a_1 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  (t : CerberusHeapLang.Step M a a_1),
  (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool}
      {pe1 pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
      {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
      {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
      (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty))
      (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv))) (h3 : valueFromPexpr pe3 = some cv)
      (hmv : memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv)
      (hmem :
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ')),
      motive
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Store0 lk pe1 pe2 pe3 mo)))),
          ρ, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr []
            (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp] (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
          ρ, σ')
        ⋯) →
    (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
        {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
        {mo : memory_order} {mval : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
        {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
        (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty))
        (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))
        (hmem :
          CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.loadM M.tagDefs loc ty pv) σ = some ((fp, mval), σ')),
        motive
          (generic_expr.Expr a (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Load0 pe1 pe2 mo)))),
            ρ, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr []
              (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp]
                (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (valueFromMemValue mval).snd))))),
            ρ, σ')
          ⋯) →
      (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
          {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype}
          {pref : prefix0} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
          {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} (h1 : valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vobject (OVinteger align)))
          (h2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vctype ty))
          (hmem :
            CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject M.tagDefs 0 pref align ty none none)
                σ =
              some (pv, σ')),
          motive
            (generic_expr.Expr a
                (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Create pe1 pe2 pref)))),
              ρ, σ)
            (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))), ρ, σ')
            ⋯) →
        (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
            {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
            motive
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
                ev0 :: evs, σ)
              (e2, ev0 :: evs, σ) ⋯) →
          (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
              {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
              {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
              motive
                (generic_expr.Expr a
                    (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                      (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
                  ev0 :: evs, σ)
                (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, σ) ⋯) →
            (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
                {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                motive
                  (generic_expr.Expr a
                      (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
                    ev0 :: evs, σ)
                  (e2, ev0 :: evs, σ) ⋯) →
              (∀ {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value}
                  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                  motive
                    (generic_expr.Expr a
                        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
                          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
                      ev0 :: evs, σ)
                    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, σ) ⋯) →
                (∀ {a pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type} {ov : object_value}
                    {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                    {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                    motive
                      (generic_expr.Expr a
                          (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                              (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))))
                            e2),
                        ev0 :: evs, σ)
                      (e2,
                        update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty) (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))
                          (ev0 :: evs),
                        σ)
                      ⋯) →
                  (∀ {a pa pb : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                      {ds : List dyn_annotation} {ov : object_value}
                      {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                      {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                      motive
                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                            (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))))
                              e2),
                          ev0 :: evs, σ)
                        (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2),
                          update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa pb x bty)
                            (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) (ev0 :: evs),
                          σ)
                        ⋯) →
                    (∀ {a : List annot} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value}
                        {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                        (hnv : valueFromPexpr pe = none)
                        (hv : CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe = some v),
                        motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Epure pe), ρ, σ)
                          (generic_expr.Expr a (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval v))), ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                      (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {ann : core_run_annotation}
                          {ty : ctype} {pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue}
                          {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                          {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} (hnv2 : valueFromPexpr pe2 = none)
                          (hv2 :
                            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 =
                              some (Vobject (OVpointer pv))),
                          motive
                            (generic_expr.Expr a
                                (Eaction
                                  (Paction polarity.Pos
                                    (Action loc ann
                                      (Load0 (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pe2 mo)))),
                              ρ, σ)
                            (generic_expr.Expr a
                                (Eaction
                                  (Paction polarity.Pos
                                    (Action loc ann
                                      (Load0 (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                                        (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) mo)))),
                              ρ, σ)
                            ⋯) →
                        (∀ {a : List annot} {pat : pattern} {e1 e1' e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                            {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                            (hnj : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none)
                            (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ')),
                            motive (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ') a_2 →
                              motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2), ρ, σ)
                                (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1' e2), ρ', σ') ⋯) →
                          (∀ {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
                              {e1 e1' e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                              {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                              (hnj : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none)
                              (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ')),
                              motive (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ') a_2 →
                                motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2), ρ, σ)
                                  (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1' e2), ρ', σ') ⋯) →
                            (∀ {a : List annot} {ds : List dyn_annotation}
                                {b b' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                (hnj : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b = none)
                                (a_2 : CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = false)
                                (a_3 : CerberusHeapLang.Step M (b, ρ, σ) (b', ρ', σ')),
                                motive (b, ρ, σ) (b', ρ', σ') a_3 →
                                  motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b), ρ, σ)
                                    (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b'), ρ', σ') ⋯) →
                              (∀ {a1 a2 : List annot} {ds1 ds2 : List dyn_annotation}
                                  {b : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                                  motive
                                    (generic_expr.Expr a1
                                        (Eannot ds1 (generic_expr.Expr a2 (Eannot ds2 b))),
                                      ρ, σ)
                                    (generic_expr.Expr (a1 ++ a2) (Eannot (ds1 ++ ds2) b), ρ, σ)
                                    ⋯) →
                                (∀ {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {l : sym}
                                    {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                    {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
                                    {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value}
                                    {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
                                    {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                    (hj : CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes))
                                    (hl :
                                      CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont))
                                    (hvs :
                                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs)
                                          pes =
                                        some vs),
                                    motive (e, ev0 :: evs, σ)
                                      (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs), σ)
                                      ⋯) →
                                  (∀ {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
                                      {ps :
                                        List
                                          (sym ×
                                            (core_base_type ×
                                                Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                              generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                      {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value}
                                      {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
                                      {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                      (hvals :
                                        valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                                          some cvals),
                                      motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ev0 :: evs, σ)
                                        (body,
                                          CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals (ev0 :: evs), σ)
                                        ⋯) →
                                    (∀ {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
                                        {ps :
                                          List
                                            (sym ×
                                              (core_base_type ×
                                                  Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) ×
                                                generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
                                        {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value}
                                        {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                        (hnv :
                                          valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                                            none)
                                        (hvals :
                                          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ
                                              (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
                                            some cvals),
                                        motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, σ)
                                          (generic_expr.Expr a
                                              (Esave sb
                                                (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals)
                                                body),
                                            ρ, σ)
                                          ⋯) →
                                      (∀ {a : List annot} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                          {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                          {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                          (hg :
                                            CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ g =
                                              some Vtrue),
                                          motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3), ρ, σ)
                                            (e2, ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                                        (∀ {a : List annot} {g : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                            {e2 e3 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                            {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                            {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                            (hg :
                                              CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ g =
                                                some Vfalse),
                                            motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Eif g e2 e3), ρ, σ)
                                              (e3, ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                                          (∀ {a : List annot} {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                              {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)}
                                              {cval : value} {e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                              {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                              {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                              (hv : valueFromPexpr pe = some cval)
                                              (hsel :
                                                select_case subst_sym_expr cval pats = some e'),
                                              motive (generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase pe pats), ρ, σ)
                                                (e', ρ, σ) ⋯) →
                                            (∀ {a pa : List annot} {x : sym} {bty : core_base_type}
                                                {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr}
                                                {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
                                                {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
                                                motive
                                                  (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                      (Esseq (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty)
                                                        (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                                                          (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v))
                                                        e2),
                                                    ev0 :: evs, σ)
                                                  (e2,
                                                    update_env (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa x bty) v
                                                      (ev0 :: evs),
                                                    σ)
                                                  ⋯) →
                                              (∀ {a : List annot} {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                  {pv1 pv2 : CerbMem.PointerValue} {b : Bool}
                                                  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                  (h1 :
                                                    valueFromPexpr pe1 =
                                                      some (Vobject (OVpointer pv1)))
                                                  (h2 :
                                                    valueFromPexpr pe2 =
                                                      some (Vobject (OVpointer pv2)))
                                                  (hmem :
                                                    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
                                                        (CerbMem.eqPtrval default pv1 pv2) σ =
                                                      some (b, σ')),
                                                  motive
                                                    (generic_expr.Expr a (Ememop PtrEq [pe1, pe2]),
                                                      ρ, σ)
                                                    (generic_expr.Expr []
                                                        (Epure
                                                          (Pexpr [] ()
                                                            (PEval
                                                              (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue b)))),
                                                      ρ, σ')
                                                    ⋯) →
                                                (∀ {a : List annot} {mop : memop}
                                                    {pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                    {v1 v2 : value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                    {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                    (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe1, pe2] = none)
                                                    (hv1 :
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern
                                                          ρ pe1 =
                                                        some v1)
                                                    (hv2 :
                                                      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern
                                                          ρ pe2 =
                                                        some v2),
                                                    motive
                                                      (generic_expr.Expr a (Ememop mop [pe1, pe2]),
                                                        ρ, σ)
                                                      (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                          (Ememop mop
                                                            [Pexpr [] () (PEval v1),
                                                              Pexpr [] () (PEval v2)]),
                                                        ρ, σ)
                                                      ⋯) →
                                                  (∀ {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
                                                      {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool}
                                                      {ty : ctype}
                                                      {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
                                                      {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
                                                      {mo : memory_order}
                                                      {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                                                      {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
                                                      (hnv : valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none)
                                                      (hv2 :
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                            M.extern ρ pe2 =
                                                          some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))
                                                      (hv3 :
                                                        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs
                                                            M.extern ρ pe3 =
                                                          some cv),
                                                      motive
                                                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                            (Eaction
                                                              (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                (Action loc ann
                                                                  (Store0 lk
                                                                    (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                      (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                                                                    pe2 pe3 mo)))),
                                                          ρ, σ)
                                                        (generic_expr.Expr a
                                                            (Eaction
                                                              (Paction polarity.Pos
                                                                (Action loc ann
                                                                  (Store0 lk
                                                                    (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                      (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                                                                    (Pexpr [] ()
                                                                      (PEval
                                                                        (Vobject (OVpointer pv))))
                                                                    (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv)) mo)))),
                                                          ρ, σ)
                                                        ⋯) →
                                                    motive a a_1 t
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.run :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs) pes = some vs →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, σ)
          (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs), σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.run_of_jumpRedex :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {l : sym}
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {params : List (sym × core_base_type)}
  {cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {vs : List value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e = some (l, pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern (ev0 :: evs) pes = some vs →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e, ev0 :: evs, σ)
          (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs), σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.save :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ev0 :: evs, σ)
      (body, CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals (ev0 :: evs), σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.save_eval :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {cvals : List value} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
        some cvals →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) body), ρ, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.save_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, σ) out →
    (∃ cvals ev0 evs,
        ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
          valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals ∧
            out = (body, CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals ρ, σ)) ∨
      ∃ cvals,
        valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
              some cvals ∧
            out =
              (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) body),
                ρ, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.save_op_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, σ) out →
      ∃ cvals,
        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) =
            some cvals ∧
          out =
            (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamsWithValues ps cvals) body),
              ρ, σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.save_vals_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {sb : sym × core_base_type}
  {ps :
    List
      (sym × (core_base_type × Option (ctype × pass_by_value_or_pointer)) × generic_pexpr Unit sym)}
  {body : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {cvals : List value}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs (CerberusHeapLang.saveParamPexprs ps) = some cvals →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esave sb ps body), ρ, σ) out →
      ∃ ev0 evs, ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (body, CerberusHeapLang.bindSaveParams ps cvals ρ, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_annot :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type}
  {ds : List dyn_annotation} {v : value} {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
  {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) e2),
      ev0 :: evs, σ)
    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ev0 :: evs, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_ctx :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e1' e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2), ρ, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1' e2), ρ', σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2), ρ, σ) out →
    (∃ e1' ρ' σ',
        CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ') ∧
            out = (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1' e2), ρ', σ')) ∨
      (∃ pa bty v ev0 evs,
          pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
            e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ∧
              ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (e2, ρ, σ)) ∨
        (∃ pa bty ds v ev0 evs,
            pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
              e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ρ, σ)) ∨
          (∃ l pes params cont vs ev0 evs,
              CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = some (l, pes) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
                      out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, σ)) ∨
            (∃ pa' pb' x bty' ov ev0 evs,
                pat = CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty' ∧
                  e1 =
                      CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                        (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))) ∧
                    ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                      out =
                        (e2,
                          update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty')
                            (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) ρ,
                          σ)) ∨
              (∃ pa' pb' x bty' ds ov ev0 evs,
                  pat = CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty' ∧
                    e1 =
                        CerberusHeapLang.ofVal
                          (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds (Vloaded (LVspecified ov))) ∧
                      ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                        out =
                          (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2),
                            update_env (CerberusHeapLang.specPat pa' pb' x bty')
                              (Vloaded (LVspecified ov)) ρ,
                            σ)) ∨
                ∃ pa' x bty' v ev0 evs,
                  pat = CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa' x bty' ∧
                    e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ∧
                      ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                        out = (e2, update_env (CerberusHeapLang.symPat pa' x bty') v ρ, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.sseq_pure :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}

    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Esseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.store :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {pe1 pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {ty : ctype}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue}
  {fp : CerbMem.Footprint} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexpr pe1 = some (Vctype ty) →
    valueFromPexpr pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      valueFromPexpr pe3 = some cv →
        memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
          CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ') →
            CerberusHeapLang.Step M
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Eaction (Paction polarity.Pos (Action loc ann (Store0 lk pe1 pe2 pe3 mo)))),
                ρ, σ)
              (generic_expr.Expr []
                  (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp]
                    (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
                ρ, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_canonical :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
  {mo : memory_order} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} {fp : CerbMem.Footprint}
  {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction
              (Paction polarity.Pos
                (Action loc ann
                  (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                    (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv)) mo)))),
          ρ, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr []
            (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp] (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
          ρ, σ')
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_eval :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value} {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) →
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe3 = some cv →
        CerberusHeapLang.Step M
          (generic_expr.Expr a
              (Eaction
                (Paction polarity.Pos
                  (Action loc ann (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pe2 pe3 mo)))),
            ρ, σ)
          (generic_expr.Expr a
              (Eaction
                (Paction polarity.Pos
                  (Action loc ann
                    (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                      (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv))
                      mo)))),
            ρ, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {cv : value}
  {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
      (generic_expr.Expr a
          (Eaction
            (Paction polarity.Pos
              (Action loc ann
                (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                  (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv)) mo)))),
        ρ, σ)
      out →
    ∃ mv fp σ',
      memValueFromValue M.tagDefs (Ctype [] (unatomic_ ty)) cv = some mv ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.storeM M.tagDefs loc ty lk pv mv) σ = some (fp, σ') ∧
          out =
            (generic_expr.Expr []
                (Eannot [DA_pos [] fp] (generic_expr.Expr [] (Epure (Pexpr [] () (PEval Vunit))))),
              ρ, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.store_op_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc}
  {ann : core_run_annotation} {lk : Bool} {ty : ctype} {pe2 pe3 : generic_pexpr Unit sym}
  {mo : memory_order} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  valueFromPexprs [pe2, pe3] = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M
        (generic_expr.Expr a
            (Eaction
              (Paction polarity.Pos
                (Action loc ann (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty))) pe2 pe3 mo)))),
          ρ, σ)
        out →
      ∃ pv cv,
        CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe2 = some (Vobject (OVpointer pv)) ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pe3 = some cv ∧
            out =
              (generic_expr.Expr a
                  (Eaction
                    (Paction polarity.Pos
                      (Action loc ann
                        (Store0 lk (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vctype ty)))
                          (Pexpr [] () (PEval (Vobject (OVpointer pv)))) (Pexpr [] () (PEval cv))
                          mo)))),
                ρ, σ)
----

ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_ctx :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e1' e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none →
    CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ') →
      CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2), ρ, σ)
        (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1' e2), ρ', σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_inv :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a : List annot} {pat : pattern}
  {e1 e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {out : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr × CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1 e2), ρ, σ) out →
    (∃ e1' ρ' σ',
        CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = none ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.Step M (e1, ρ, σ) (e1', ρ', σ') ∧
            out = (generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq pat e1' e2), ρ', σ')) ∨
      (∃ pa bty v ev0 evs,
          pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
            e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v) ∧
              ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (e2, ρ, σ)) ∨
        (∃ pa bty ds v ev0 evs,
            pat = Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)) ∧
              e1 = CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v) ∧
                ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧ out = (generic_expr.Expr [] (Eannot ds e2), ρ, σ)) ∨
          ∃ l pes params cont vs ev0 evs,
            CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1 = some (l, pes) ∧
              ρ = ev0 :: evs ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) ∧
                  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs M.tagDefs M.extern ρ pes = some vs ∧
                    out = (cont, CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs ρ, σ)
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.Step.wseq_pure :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {a pa : List annot} {bty : core_base_type} {v : value}
  {e2 : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value} {evs : List (Fmap sym value)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.Step M
    (generic_expr.Expr a
        (Ewseq (Pattern pa (CaseBase (none, bty)))
          (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) e2),
      ev0 :: evs, σ)
    (e2, ev0 :: evs, σ)

inductive CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap → ctype → CerbMem.MemValue → Prop
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.bytes_fpm :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd
----
def CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.casesOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {ty : ctype} →
    {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv) →
          ((compat : CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true) →
              (fpm : ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
                (len :
                    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length =
                        CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
                  (bytes_fpm :
                      ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                    (stored_dec :
                        ∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
                          CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                            CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                      motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.compat :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.fpm :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.len :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty
----
ctor CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.mk :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true →
    (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
      (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
        (∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd = (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
          (∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
              CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                  (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
            CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv
----
rec CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.rec :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {ty : ctype} →
    {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv → Sort u} →
        ((compat : CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true) →
            (fpm : ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
              (len :
                  ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                    (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
                (bytes_fpm :
                    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                  (stored_dec :
                      ∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
                        CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty
                            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                          CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                            (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                    motive ⋯) →
          (t : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv) → motive t
----
def CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.recOn :
{tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} →
  {ty : ctype} →
    {mv : CerbMem.MemValue} →
      {motive : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv → Sort u} →
        (t : CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv) →
          ((compat : CerbMem.ctypeMemCompatible ty (CerbMem.typeofMval mv) = true) →
              (fpm : ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap), (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).fst = fpm) →
                (len :
                    ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                      (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd.length =
                        CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) →
                  (bytes_fpm :
                      ∀ (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
                        (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds fpm mv).snd =
                          (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                    (stored_dec :
                        ∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
                          CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
                            CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty
                              (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd) →
                      motive ⋯) →
            motive t
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt.stored_dec :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ty : ctype} {mv : CerbMem.MemValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.StorableAt tds ty mv →
    ∀ (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap) (addr : Int),
      CerbMem.reconstructValue tds lum fpm addr ty (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd =
        CerbMem.reconstructValue tds [] [] addr ty (CerbMem.memValueToBytes tds [] mv).snd
----

def CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor → CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq → Option CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor_mk :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (la nid al : Int) (ty : ctype),
  CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor tds { lastAddr := la, nextId := nid } { align := al, ty := ty } =
    if
        0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la al (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 then
      some
        { lastAddr := CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la al (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
          nextId := nid + 1 }
    else none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor_pos :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor) (r : CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds r.ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.freshBase c.lastAddr r.align (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds r.ty) ≠ 0 →
      CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor tds c r =
        some
          {
            lastAddr :=
              CerberusHeapLang.freshBase c.lastAddr r.align (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds r.ty),
            nextId := c.nextId + 1 }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor_some_inv :
∀ {c c' : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} {r : CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq} (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap),
  CerberusHeapLang.advanceCursor tds c r = some c' →
    0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds r.ty ∧
      CerberusHeapLang.freshBase c.lastAddr r.align (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds r.ty) ≠ 0 ∧
        c' =
          {
            lastAddr :=
              CerberusHeapLang.freshBase c.lastAddr r.align (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds r.ty),
            nextId := c.nextId + 1 }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.advance_action :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {tid : Nat} {s : String}
  {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {req : action_request2 thread_state} {dst dst' : driver_state},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne
        (action_request_sequential2 tds loc tid dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply req)
        { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
          core_state0 := dst.core_state0,
          core_run_state0 :=
            have __src := dst.core_run_state0;
            { tid_supply := __src.tid_supply, aid_supply := dst.core_run_state0.aid_supply + 1,
              excluded_supply := __src.excluded_supply, sym_supply := __src.sym_supply,
              labeled := __src.labeled },
          layout_state := dst.layout_state, concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,
          fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0, trace := dst.trace, symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc,
          blocked := dst.blocked, dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter } =
      (NDactive (), dst') →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne
        (advance_step tds tid (Step_action_request2 s loc tid false (stExceptUndef_return req)))
        dst =
      (NDactive NOWAKEUP, dst')
----

def CerberusHeapLang.allocCap :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbTags.TagDefsMap → List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocCap_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor)
  (reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq),
  CerberusHeapLang.PlanFits tds c reqs →
    c.lastAddr ≤ 2 ^ 64 → CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.allocCap tds reqs
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocCap_weaken :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (reqs rest : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq),
  CerberusHeapLang.allocCap tds (reqs ++ rest) ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.allocCap tds reqs
----
def CerberusHeapLang.allocMeta :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → CerbTags.TagDefsMap → Int → Int → ctype → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocMeta_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a a' : Int) (aty aty' : ctype),
  CerberusHeapLang.allocMeta tds id a aty ∗ CerberusHeapLang.allocMeta tds id a' aty' ⊢
    ⌜a = a' ∧ aty = aty'⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocMeta_persistent :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype),
  Iris.BI.Persistent (CerberusHeapLang.allocMeta tds id a aty)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_create_launch_smoke :
∀ (pref : prefix0) (aids : Nat → Nat),
  ∃ v σ',
    CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids 2
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx.thread
            (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
              (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none 4) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref)
            [fmapEmpty])
          CerberusHeapLang.prodMem₀ =
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' ∧
      ∃ pv, v = Vobject (OVpointer pv)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_create_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF} (al : Int)
  (pref : prefix0) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs [{ align := al, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy }] ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wpt M Ls 2
      (fun x x_1 =>
        iprop(∃ p,
            p ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes M.tagDefs ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs []))
      (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
        (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none al) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref)
      ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.alloc_two_creates_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF} (al₁ al₂ : Int)
  (pref₁ pref₂ : prefix0) (bty : core_base_type) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs
      [{ align := al₁, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy },
        { align := al₂, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy }] ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.wps M Ls
      (fun x x_1 =>
        iprop(∃ p₁ p₂,
            p₁ ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes M.tagDefs ∗
              p₂ ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
                  CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes M.tagDefs ∗
                CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs []))
      (CerberusHeapLang.sseqExpr bty
        (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
          (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none al₁) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref₁)
        (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation
          (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV CerbMem.Provenance.Prov_none al₂) CerberusHeapLang.intTy pref₂))
      (ev0 :: evs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateObject_layer :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (tid : Nat) (pref : prefix0) (align : CerbMem.IntegerValue)
  (ty : ctype) (reqAddr : Option Int) (initOpt : Option CerbMem.MemValue)
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  (∃ pv σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid pref align ty reqAddr initOpt) σ =
        (NDactive pv, σ')) ∨
    ∃ r σ',
      CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateObject tds tid pref align ty reqAddr initOpt) σ =
        (NDkilled r, σ')
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.allocateObject_success :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (pref : prefix0)
  (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int) (ty : ctype),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) ≠ 0 →
      CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM
          (CerbMem.allocateObject tds 0 pref (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN) ty none none)
          σ =
        some
          (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr σ.nextAllocId
              (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty)),
            CerbMem.writeBytesTo
              { nextAllocId := σ.nextAllocId + 1, nextIota := σ.nextIota,
                lastAddress :=
                  CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
                allocations :=
                  σ.allocations.insert σ.nextAllocId
                    {
                      base :=
                        CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN
                          (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty),
                      size := ↑(CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty), ty := some ty, prefix_ := pref },
                iotaMap := σ.iotaMap, funptrmap := σ.funptrmap, varargs := σ.varargs,
                nextVarargsId := σ.nextVarargsId, bytemap := σ.bytemap,
                lastUsedUnionMembers := σ.lastUsedUnionMembers,
                deadAllocations := σ.deadAllocations, dynamicAddrs := σ.dynamicAddrs,
                lastUsed := σ.lastUsed, requested := σ.requested }
              (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase σ.lastAddress alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty))
              (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte))
----

CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Bool

def CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM :
{α : Type} → CerbMem.memM α → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Option (α × CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM_ND :
∀ {α : Type}
  (f :
    CerberusHeapLang.Mem →
      nd_action α String mem_error (mem_constraint CerbMem.IntegerValue) CerbMem.MemState ×
        CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem), CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (ND f) σ = CerberusHeapLang.ndProj (f σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM_eq_ndProj :
∀ {α : Type} (m : CerbMem.memM α) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM m σ = CerberusHeapLang.ndProj (CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM_none_killed :
∀ {α : Type} {m : CerbMem.memM α} {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  ((∃ z σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ = (NDactive z, σ')) ∨
      ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ = (NDkilled r, σ')) →
    CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM m σ = none → ∃ r σ', CerberusHeapLang.runOne m σ = (NDkilled r, σ')

          (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrameX (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal x) (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i)
              (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal acc) (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a)))

            rest)
          [CerberusHeapLang.arrIncPe, CerberusHeapLang.arrAccXPe, CerberusHeapLang.arrShiftPe] =

theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_blockSpecs :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length) →
    vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
      ∀ (ety : integerType),
        (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                  (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
              CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
          ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs)
              (CerberusHeapLang.arrLs vs id a aty bs) (CerberusHeapLang.arrPost vs id a aty bs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length) →
    vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
      ∀ (ety : integerType),
        (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                  (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
              CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
          ∀ (i : Nat) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
            CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
              i ≤ vs.length →
                CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs).tagDefs id
                    (Iris.DFrac.own 1) { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ⊢
                  CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrLs vs id a aty bs)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrPost vs id a aty bs)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrBody loc ann ra mo xbty ↑vs.length)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.arrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal ↑i)
                        (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (List.take i vs).sum)
                        (Vobject (OVpointer (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id (a + ↑(4 * i))))) f ::
                      rest)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.arr_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p
      (CerberusHeapLang.arrQ loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length) →
    vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
      ∀ (ety : integerType),
        (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
            CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
                (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                  (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
              CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
          ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs).tagDefs id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs } ⊢
              WP
                {
                  e :=
                    CerberusHeapLang.arrProg loc ann ra mo sbty ibty accbty pbty xbty
                      (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) ↑vs.length,
                  ρ := [fmapEmpty], M := CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs } @
                Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                ⊤ {{
                  w,
                    ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                      Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                        ⌜w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal vs.sum ∧
                            CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs).tagDefs σ' id
                              { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs }⌝ }}
