theorem CerberusHeapLang.array_sum_certified :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (ibty accbty pbty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (vs : List Int) (id a : Int) (aty : ctype)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  vs.length * 4 ≤ CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty aty →
    ∀ (ety : integerType),
      (∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < vs.length) (lum : List (Int × identifier)) (fpm : CerbMem.Funptrmap),
          CerbMem.reconstructValue fmapEmpty lum fpm (a + ↑(4 * i)) CerberusHeapLang.intTy
              (List.take (CerbMem.sizeofCtype fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.intTy)
                (List.drop (4 * i) bs)) =
            CerbMem.MemValue.MVinteger ety (CerbMem.integerIval vs[i])) →
        ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
          CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀
              (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton id { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs }) →
            ∀ (nsteps : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
              have prog :=
                CerberusHeapLang.arrProg loc ann ra mo sbty ibty accbty pbty xbty
                  (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id a) ↑vs.length;
              have rs := CerberusHeapLang.arrRS loc ann ra mo ibty accbty pbty xbty ↑vs.length;
              (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
                  CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym rs)
                      aids nsteps
                      (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym prog [fmapEmpty])
                      σ₀ ≠
                    CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym rs)
                      aids nsteps
                      (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym prog [fmapEmpty])
                      σ₀ ≠
                    CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
                  ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                    CerberusHeapLang.driveU
                          (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym rs) aids nsteps
                          (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.arrProcSym prog [fmapEmpty])
                          σ₀ =
                        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
                      v = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal vs.sum ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' id
                          { addr := a, ty := aty, bytes := bs }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ars_create_active :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {pref : prefix0}
  {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype} {reqAddr : Option Int}
  {initOpt : Option CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat → CerbMem.PointerValue → thread_state}
  {tid aid : Nat} {dst : driver_state} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject tds 0 pref align ty reqAddr initOpt)
        dst.layout_state =
      some (pv, σ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne
        (action_request_sequential2 tds loc tid aid
          (CreateRequest2 pref align ty reqAddr initOpt k))
        dst =
      (NDactive (),
        { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
          core_state0 := update_thread_state tid (k aid pv) dst.core_state0,
          core_run_state0 := dst.core_run_state0, layout_state := σ',
          concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state, fs_state0 := dst.fs_state0,
          trace := ME_allocate_object tid pref align ty initOpt pv :: dst.trace,
          symbolic_assoc := dst.symbolic_assoc, blocked := dst.blocked,
          dr_step_counter := dst.dr_step_counter })

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ars_create_killed :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {pref : prefix0}
  {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype} {reqAddr : Option Int}
  {initOpt : Option CerbMem.MemValue} {k : Nat → CerbMem.PointerValue → thread_state}
  {tid aid : Nat} {dst : driver_state} {r : kill_reason mem_error} {σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem},
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (CerbMem.allocateObject tds 0 pref align ty reqAddr initOpt)
        dst.layout_state =

        (action_request_sequential2 tds loc tid aid

          (match r with
          | Undef0 l ubs => Undef0 l ubs
          | Error0 l s => Error0 l s
          | Other err => Other (DErr_memory err)),
        { core_file := dst.core_file, core_extern := dst.core_extern,
          core_state0 := dst.core_state0, core_run_state0 := dst.core_run_state0,
          layout_state := σ', concurrency_state := dst.concurrency_state,

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bind_branch_active :
∀ {a b cs err info st : Type} (n : Nat) {m : ndM a info err cs st} {f : a → ndM b info err cs st}

def CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF →
          (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) → Iris.IProp GF
----
def CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
        CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF →
          (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF) → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (R : Iris.IProp GF),
  CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M Ls Ψ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M (CerberusHeapLang.frameLsT R Ls) fun w ρ' => iprop(Ψ w ρ' ∗ R)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
      (vs : List value) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (m : Nat),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
        Ls l m vs (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt M Ls m Ψ cont (CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs))) →
    ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M Ls Ψ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT_mono :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack), Ψ₁ w ρ' ⊢ Ψ₂ w ρ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M Ls Ψ₁ ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT M Ls Ψ₂
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs_frame :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF} (R : Iris.IProp GF),
  CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M Ls Ψ ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M (CerberusHeapLang.frameLs R Ls) fun w ρ' => iprop(Ψ w ρ' ∗ R)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Ψ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)
      (vs : List value) (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
        Ls l vs (ev0 :: evs) ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps M Ls Ψ cont (CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs (ev0 :: evs))) →
    ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M Ls Ψ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs_mono :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF}
  {Ψ₁ Ψ₂ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF},
  (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal) (ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack), Ψ₁ w ρ' ⊢ Ψ₂ w ρ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M Ls Ψ₁ ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecs M Ls Ψ₂

theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteAt_of_readBytesFrom :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (n : Nat) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ a n = bs →
    ∀ (j : Nat), j < n → CerberusHeapLang.byteAt σ (a + ↑j) = bs[j]?.getD CerberusHeapLang.undefByte
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteAt_writeBytesTo_in :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (k : Int) (h1 : a ≤ k)
  (h2 : k < a + ↑bs.length),
  CerberusHeapLang.byteAt (CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ a bs) k = bs[(k - a).toNat]
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteAt_writeBytesTo_out :
∀ (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (a : Int) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (k : Int),
  ¬(a ≤ k ∧ k < a + ↑bs.length) →
    CerberusHeapLang.byteAt (CerbMem.writeBytesTo σ a bs) k = CerberusHeapLang.byteAt σ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteHeap_alloc_big :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  (mbnew : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte),
  Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint mbnew mb →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union mbnew mb) ∗
          [∗map] k ↦ b ∈ mbnew, CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteHeap_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {k : Int} {b : CerbMem.AbsByte}
  (b' : CerbMem.AbsByte),
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b ==∗
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp (Iris.Std.insert mb k b') ∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k (Iris.DFrac.own 1) b'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.byteHeap_valid :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {k : Int} {dq : Iris.DFrac}
  {b : CerbMem.AbsByte},
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k dq b ==∗
      ⌜Iris.Std.get? mb k = some b⌝

  (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (b₁ b₂ : CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k dq₁ b₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn k dq₂ b₂ ⊢ ⌜b₁ = b₂⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_agree :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq₁ dq₂ : Iris.DFrac) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  bs₁.length = bs₂.length →
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq₁ bs₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq₂ bs₂ ⊢ ⌜bs₁ = bs₂⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_append :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (bs₁ bs₂ : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq (bs₁ ++ bs₂) ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs₁ ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + ↑bs₁.length) dq bs₂
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_cons :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (dq : Iris.DFrac) (b : CerbMem.AbsByte) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq (b :: bs) =
    iprop(CerberusHeapLang.byteOwn a dq b ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn (a + 1) dq bs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_fractional :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] (a : Int)
  (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) bs ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own q₁) bs ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own q₂) bs

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_get :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte) (a : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac)
  (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a dq bs ⊢

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_read :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}

  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte) (a : Int) (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte),
  bs'.length = bs.length →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp (CerberusHeapLang.insertRange mb a bs') ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn a (Iris.DFrac.own 1) bs'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.bytesToInt_go_cons :
∀ (p : CerbMem.Provenance) (c : Option Int) (v : UInt8) (rest : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (i : Nat)
  (acc : Int),
  CerbMem.bytesToInt.go ({ prov := p, copyOffset := c, value := some v } :: rest) i acc =
    CerbMem.bytesToInt.go rest (i + 1) (acc + ↑v.toNat <<< (i * 8))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.case_blockSpecs :

  (v : value),
  ⊢

      iprop(⌜w.val = v⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.case_certified :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] (v : value)
  (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (n : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
  (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
      CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread (CerberusHeapLang.caseProg v)) σ₀ ≠
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
    CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread (CerberusHeapLang.caseProg v)) σ₀ ≠
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
      ∀ (v' : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
              (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread (CerberusHeapLang.caseProg v)) σ₀ =
            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v' σ' →
          v' = v
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.case_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (v : value),
  ⊢
    WP
      { e := CerberusHeapLang.caseProg v, ρ := CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv,
        M := CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx } @
      Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
      ⊤ {{ w, ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜w.val = v⌝ }}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_cellCoh :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}

  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap),

    ∀ (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ⊢
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ i c ∧
            Iris.Std.get? mm i = some (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c)⌝

  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (i : Int) (q₁ q₂ : Iris.Qp) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own (q₁ + q₂)) c ⊣⊢

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn_iff :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (i : Int) (dq : Iris.DFrac) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i dq c ⊣⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.metaOwn i dq (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c) ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.bytesOwn c.addr dq c.bytes ∗
        ⌜c.bytes.length = CerbMem.sizeofCtype tds c.ty ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.decIndep tds c.addr c.ty c.bytes⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cell_read_shared_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {Ls : CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpec GF} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc)
  (ann : core_run_annotation) (pv : CerbMem.PointerValue) (mo : memory_order)
  (bs bs' : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellLoadTrap M.tagDefs
        { addr := CerberusHeapLang.addrOf pv, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs } =
      false →
    pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs ∗
        pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own (Iris.Qp.half 1)} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs' ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.wps M Ls
        (fun w x =>
          iprop(⌜∃ fp,
                  w =
                    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot [DA_pos [] fp]
                      (CerberusHeapLang.loadedVal M.tagDefs pv CerberusHeapLang.intTy bs)⌝ ∗
              pv ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs))
        (CerberusHeapLang.loadExpr loc ann CerberusHeapLang.intTy pv mo) ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellsDisjoint_iff_metaDisjoint :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (c1 c2 : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.cellsDisjoint tds c1 c2 ↔
    CerberusHeapLang.metaDisjoint (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c1) (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c2)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellsOwn_consequence :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (Q : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap),
      ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ Q⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellsOwn_extract :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}

      (CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗
            [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
        ⌜CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ Q⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cellsOwn_facts :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (Q : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
      (CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ∗
            [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
        ⌜∀ (i : Int) (c : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
            Iris.Std.get? Q i = some c →
              CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh tds σ i c ∧
                Iris.Std.get? mm i = some (CerberusHeapLang.metaOf tds c)⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_consequence :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte}
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  CerberusHeapLang.CohG σ mm mb mk →
    ∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop)
      (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (vv : value),
      ((∃ Q, ⌜post vv Q⌝ ∗ [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
            [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ R, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢
        ⌜∃ Q,
            post vv Q ∧
              Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_disjoint :
CerberusHeapLang.cellsDisjoint fmapEmpty CerberusHeapLang.cellY CerberusHeapLang.cellX
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_readout :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (post : value → CerberusHeapLang.CellMap → Prop) (R : CerberusHeapLang.CellMap) (vv : value),
  ((∃ Q, ⌜post vv Q⌝ ∗ [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ Q, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
      [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ R, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn tds i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
    ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
      Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
        ⌜∃ Q,
            post vv Q ∧
              Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q R ∧
                CerberusHeapLang.Coh tds σ' (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q R)⌝
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.cells_to_mC :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
  CerberusHeapLang.xPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
        CerberusHeapLang.fiveBytes fmapEmpty ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.yPtr ↦c[fmapEmpty]{Iris.DFrac.own 1} CerberusHeapLang.intTy ;
        CerberusHeapLang.sixBytes fmapEmpty ⊢
    [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ CerberusHeapLang.mC, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.col_aux_sseq :
∀ {A : Type} (n : Nat) (st : collect_saves_state A) (a : List annot) (pat : pattern)
  (e1 e2 : generic_expr A Unit sym),
  collect_saves_aux_lemFuel (n + 1) st (generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e1 e2)) =
    union_saves st
      (union_saves
        (have __src := collect_saves_aux_lemFuel n empty_saves e1;
        {
          tmp_acc :=
            fmapMap
              (fun p =>
                match p with
                | (syms, e) => (syms, generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq pat e e2)))
              (collect_saves_aux_lemFuel n empty_saves e1).tmp_acc,
          closed_acc := __src.closed_acc })
        (collect_saves_aux_lemFuel n empty_saves e2))
----

    {
      tmp_acc :=
        CerberusHeapLang.lrQ CerberusHeapLang.loc0 empty_annotation ra mo pbty cbty bbty nbty ubty,
      closed_acc := fmapEmpty }

      ∀ (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        CerberusHeapLang.RoundComplete M (e, ρ, σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.complete_run :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} {e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ctx : context}
  {ra : core_run_annotation} {l : sym} {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)},
  CerberusHeapLang.Decomp e ctx (CerberusHeapLang.runRedex ra l pes) →
    CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ {p : sym},
        M.proc = some p →
          ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
            CerberusHeapLang.RoundComplete M (e, ev0 :: evs, σ)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (idx addr : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀
          (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton idx
            { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs0 }) →
        ∀ (nsteps : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
          have prog :=
            CerberusHeapLang.loopProg loc ann ra mo bty xbty sbty
              (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr) n;
          have rs :=
            CerberusHeapLang.loopRS loc ann ra mo bty xbty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr);
          (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
              CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym rs)
                  aids nsteps
                  (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) σ₀ ≠
                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym rs) aids
                  nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog [fmapEmpty])
                  σ₀ ≠
                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
              ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym rs)
                      aids nsteps
                      (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog [fmapEmpty])
                      σ₀ =
                    CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
                  v = Vunit ∧
                    ∃ bs',
                      (n = 0 ∧ bs' = bs0 ∨ 0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' idx
                          { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified_irrelevant_binding :
∀ (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (idx addr : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (junk : value) (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀
          (Iris.Std.PartialMap.singleton idx
            { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs0 }) →
        ∀ (nsteps : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
          have prog :=
            CerberusHeapLang.loopProg loc ann ra mo bty xbty sbty
              (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr) n;
          have rs :=
            CerberusHeapLang.loopRS loc ann ra mo bty xbty (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr idx addr);
          have ρ₀ := [CerberusHeapLang.envAdd CerberusHeapLang.ySym junk fmapEmpty];
          (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
              CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym rs)
                  aids nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog ρ₀)
                  σ₀ ≠
                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
            CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym rs) aids
                  nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog ρ₀) σ₀ ≠
                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
              ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym rs)
                      aids nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.loopProcSym prog ρ₀)
                      σ₀ =
                    CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
                  v = Vunit ∧
                    ∃ bs',
                      (n = 0 ∧ bs' = bs0 ∨ 0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' idx
                          { addr := addr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified_production :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty sbty : core_base_type)
  (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    6 * n.toNat + 8 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
        ∃ dres dst',
          CerbND.runND
                (drive fmapEmpty false
                  (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                    (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n))
                  args)
                (initial_driver_state sup
                    (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile
                      (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n))
                    fs).fst =
              [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
            dres.dres_core_value = Vunit ∧
              (∃ i a bs',
                  (n = 0 ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes fmapEmpty ∨
                      0 < n ∧ bs' = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty) ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty dst'.layout_state i
                      { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy, bytes := bs' }) ∧
                dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.counter_loop_certified_registration :
∀ (sup : Nat) (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order)
  (bty xbty sbty : core_base_type) (idx addr : Int) (bs0 : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (n : Int),

                  nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.mainSym prog [fmapEmpty])

                  nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.mainSym prog [fmapEmpty])

                      nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.mainSym prog [fmapEmpty])

                        CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty σ' idx

theorem CerberusHeapLang.create_atomic :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx} (loc : CerbLocation.Loc) (ann : core_run_annotation)
  (aprov : CerbMem.Provenance) (alignN : Int) (ty : ctype) (pref : prefix0) (la nid : Int)
  (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack),
  0 < CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty →
    CerberusHeapLang.atomicTy ty = false →
      CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) ≠ 0 →
        CerberusHeapLang.decIndep M.tagDefs
            (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty)) ty
            (List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte) →
          CerberusHeapLang.AtomicStep M
            (CerberusHeapLang.createExpr loc ann (CerbMem.IntegerValue.IV aprov alignN) ty pref) ρ 1
            (CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn { lastAddr := la, nextId := nid }) fun w =>
            iprop(⌜w =
                    CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure
                      (Vobject
                        (OVpointer
                          (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr nid
                            (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN
                              (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty)))))⌝ ∗
                CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr nid
                      (CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN
                        (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty)) ↦c[M.tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1}
                    ty ;
                    List.replicate (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty) CerberusHeapLang.undefByte ∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn
                    {
                      lastAddr :=
                        CerberusHeapLang.freshBase la alignN (CerbMem.sizeofCtype M.tagDefs ty),
                      nextId := nid + 1 })

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctrProd_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty : core_base_type) (n : Int)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) →
    ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
      0 ≤ n →
        ∀ (ev0 : Fmap sym value) (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
          CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame ev0 →
            CerberusHeapLang.allocCap (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs).tagDefs
                [{ align := 4, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy }] ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs) (CerberusHeapLang.ctrLsT n)
                (2 +
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrCost n.toNat +
                    CerberusHeapLang.saveEntryCost (CerberusHeapLang.ctrParams xbty cbty n)))
                (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (CerberusHeapLang.ψC n))
                (CerberusHeapLang.counterProdProg ra mo bty xbty cbty sbty n) (ev0 :: evs)

  CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) l = some (params, cont) →

      cont = CerberusHeapLang.ctrBody ra mo bty

theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctr_body_wpt :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (mo : memory_order) (bty xbty cbty : core_base_type) (n : Int)
  (p : sym) (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.ctrQ ra mo bty xbty cbty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (pptr : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (f : Fmap sym value)
      (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            i = n ∧ bs = CerberusHeapLang.intUndefBytes fmapEmpty ∨
                i < n ∧ bs = CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs).tagDefs →
              pptr ↦c[(CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs).tagDefs]{Iris.DFrac.own 1}
                  CerberusHeapLang.intTy ; bs ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs) (CerberusHeapLang.ctrLsT n)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrCost i.toNat)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.readoutPost (CerberusHeapLang.ψC n))
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrBody ra mo bty)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.ctrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i)
                      (CerberusHeapLang.ptrVal pptr) f ::
                    rest)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.ctr_guard_eval :
∀ {f : Fmap sym value},
  CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
    ∀ (rest : List (Fmap sym value)) (i : Int) (vc : value),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr fmapEmpty fmapEmpty
          (CerberusHeapLang.ctrFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i) vc f :: rest)
          CerberusHeapLang.ctrGuardPe =
        some (CerberusHeapLang.boolValue (decide (0 < i)))

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cursorHeap_alloc :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor}

  Iris.Std.get? mk 0 = none →
    ⊢
      CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ==∗
        CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp (Iris.Std.insert mk 0 c) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cursorHeap_update :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor} {c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor}
  (c' : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor),
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c ==∗
      CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp (Iris.Std.insert mk 0 c') ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.cursorHeap_valid :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mk : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor}
  {c : CerberusHeapLang.AllocCursor},
  ⊢
    CerberusHeapLang.cursorInterp mk ∗ CerberusHeapLang.cursorOwn c ==∗
      ⌜Iris.Std.get? mk 0 = some c⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.dischargeStep_create_active :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {aid : Nat} {rs : core_run_state} {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem}
  {str : String} {loc : CerbLocation.Loc} {tid : thread_id} {uw : Bool} {pref : prefix0}
  {align : CerbMem.IntegerValue} {ty : ctype} {reqAddr : Option Int}
  {k : Nat → CerbMem.PointerValue → thread_state} {pv : CerbMem.PointerValue},
  CerberusHeapLang.applyMemM (CerbMem.allocateObject tds 0 pref align ty reqAddr none) σ =
      some (pv, σ') →
    CerberusHeapLang.dischargeStep tds aid rs σ
        (Step_action_request2 str loc tid uw
          (stExceptUndef_return (CreateRequest2 pref align ty reqAddr none k))) =
      CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.next (k aid pv) σ'

theorem CerberusHeapLang.diverge_total_unprovable :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] (ra : core_run_annotation)
  (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
  CerberusHeapLang.Coh fmapEmpty σ₀ m₀ →
    ∀ (Ls : [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] → CerberusHeapLang.LabelSpecT GF)
      (Ψ :
        [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] →
          CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → Iris.IProp GF)
      (k : Nat),
      (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
          ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
            CerberusHeapLang.blockSpecsT
                (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.dgProcSym (CerberusHeapLang.dgRS ra)) Ls
                Ψ ∗
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt
                (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.dgProcSym (CerberusHeapLang.dgRS ra)) Ls
                k Ψ (CerberusHeapLang.dgBody ra) [fmapEmpty]) →
        False

def CerberusHeapLang.driveU :
CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx →
  (Nat → Nat) → Nat → thread_state → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driveU_succ :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (aids : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) (th : thread_state)
  (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
  CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids (n + 1) th σ =
    match CerberusHeapLang.stepOutcomes M (aids 0) th σ with
    | [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.next th' σ'] =>
      CerberusHeapLang.driveU M (fun i => aids (i + 1)) n th' σ'
    | [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.done v] => CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ
    | [CerberusHeapLang.EngineOutcome.killed r] => CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r
    | x => CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driveU_value_pure :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.SeqWF →
    ∀ (φp : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop) (aids : Nat → Nat) (v : value)
      (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      (∃ w, w.val = v ∧ φp w σ) →
        ∀ (n : Nat),
          CerberusHeapLang.DriveOk φp
            (CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n
              (M.thread (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) ρ) σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.drive_after_setup :
∀ (sup : Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String)
  (dstD : driver_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.runOne (driver2_lemFuel lemDefaultFuel fmapEmpty false)
        (CerberusHeapLang.prodEntryState sup e fs) =
      (NDactive (), dstD) →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e) args)
        (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile e) fs).fst =
      (NDactive (finalize fmapEmpty "drive (without concur)" dstD), dstD)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.drive_classifyU :
∀ {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.SeqWF →
    (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
          CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
      (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
            CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
        ∀ (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ρ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
          (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
          (φp : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
          (∀ (r : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRt) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
              CerberusHeapLang.Reach ({ e := e₀, ρ := ρ₀, M := M }, σ₀) (r, σ) →
                Iris.ProgramLogic.PrimStep.NotStuck (r, σ)) →
            (∀ (w : CerberusHeapLang.CoreRVal) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                CerberusHeapLang.Reach ({ e := e₀, ρ := ρ₀, M := M }, σ₀)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ofValRt w, σ) →
                  φp w σ) →
              ∀ (n : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat) (e : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
                (evs : List (Fmap sym value)) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                CerberusHeapLang.Reach ({ e := e₀, ρ := ρ₀, M := M }, σ₀)
                    ({ e := e, ρ := ev0 :: evs, M := M }, σ) →
                  CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                    CerberusHeapLang.pot e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                      CerberusHeapLang.DriveOk φp
                        (CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e (ev0 :: evs)) σ)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driver2_done :
∀ (fl : Nat) (tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)) (dst dstF : driver_state)
  (th thF : thread_state) (v : value),
  dst.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, th)] →
    CerberusHeapLang.runOne (drive_nonmemory_steps_aux2_lemFuel lemDefaultFuel tds fmapEmpty [0])
          dst =
        (NDactive (fmapAddBy defaultCompare 0 [Step_done2 v] fmapEmpty), dstF) →
      dstF.core_state0.thread_states = [(0, none, thF)] →
        CerberusHeapLang.runOne (driver2_lemFuel fl.succ tds false) dst =
          (NDactive (),
            { core_file := dstF.core_file, core_extern := dstF.core_extern,
              core_state0 :=
                have __src := dstF.core_state0;
                {
                  thread_states :=
                    [(0, none,
                        { arena := mk_value_e v, stack0 := Stack_empty, errno := thF.errno,
                          env := thF.env, current_proc_opt := thF.current_proc_opt,
                          exec_loc := thF.exec_loc, current_loc := thF.current_loc })],
                  io := __src.io },
              core_run_state0 := dstF.core_run_state0, layout_state := dstF.layout_state,
              concurrency_state := dstF.concurrency_state, fs_state0 := dstF.fs_state0,
              trace := dstF.trace, symbolic_assoc := dstF.symbolic_assoc, blocked := dstF.blocked,
              dr_step_counter := dstF.dr_step_counter })
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDone_annot :
∀ (p : sym) (Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap) (th₀ : thread_state),
  th₀.stack0 = Stack_empty →
    ∀ (ds : List dyn_annotation) (v : value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
      (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
      ψ v σ →
        ∀ (k : Nat),
          1 ≤ k →
            CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀
              (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.annot ds v)) ρ σ ψ k
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDone_step :
∀ {M₀ : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M₀.tagDefs = fmapEmpty →
    M₀.extern = fmapEmpty →
      ∀ {Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap},
        M₀.labels = Q →
          ∀ {p : sym} {th₀ : thread_state},
            th₀.current_proc_opt = some p →
              ∀ {e e' : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr} {ev0 : Fmap sym value}
                {evs : List (Fmap sym value)} {ρ' : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
                {σ σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop} {k : Nat},
                CerberusHeapLang.Frag e →
                  CerberusHeapLang.esize e ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
                    CerberusHeapLang.Step M₀ (e, ev0 :: evs, σ) (e', ρ', σ') →
                      CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e' ρ' σ' ψ k →
                        CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀ e (ev0 :: evs) σ ψ (k + 1)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.driverDone_value :
∀ (p : sym) (Q : CerberusHeapLang.LabelMap) (th₀ : thread_state),
  th₀.stack0 = Stack_empty →
    ∀ (v : value) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)
      (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
      ψ v σ →
        ∀ (k : Nat),
          CerberusHeapLang.DriverDoneAt p Q th₀
            (CerberusHeapLang.ofVal (CerberusHeapLang.SpikeVal.pure v)) ρ σ ψ k
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_adequacyU :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.SeqWF →
    (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
          CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
      (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
            CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
        ∀ (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value) (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value))
          (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell),
          CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
            CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
              CerberusHeapLang.Coh M.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ →
                ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
                  (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                      ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                          CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ⊢
                        WP { e := e₀, ρ := ev00 :: evs0, M := M } @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                          ⊤ {{
                            w, ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜ψ w.val σ'⌝ }}
                            ) →
                    ∀ (n : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
                      (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
                          CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) σ₀ ≠
                            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) σ₀ ≠
                            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
                          ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                            CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) σ₀ =
                                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
                              ψ v σ'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_adequacyU_alloc :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF] {M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx},
  M.SeqWF →
    (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
        CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
          CerberusHeapLang.Frag cont) →
      (∀ (l : sym) (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (cont : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
          CerberusHeapLang.lookupLabel M.labels l = some (params, cont) →
            CerberusHeapLang.pot cont ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
        ∀ (e₀ : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) (ev00 : Fmap sym value) (evs0 : List (Fmap sym value))
          (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (m₀ : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.SpikeCell)
          (reqs : List CerberusHeapLang.AllocReq),
          CerberusHeapLang.Frag e₀ →
            CerberusHeapLang.pot e₀ ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
              CerberusHeapLang.LaunchCoh M.tagDefs σ₀ m₀ reqs →
                ∀ (ψ : value → CerberusHeapLang.Mem → Prop),
                  (∀ [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF],
                      ([∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m₀,
                            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn M.tagDefs i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c) ∗
                          CerberusHeapLang.allocCap M.tagDefs reqs ⊢
                        WP { e := e₀, ρ := ev00 :: evs0, M := M } @ Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
                          ⊤ {{
                            w, ∀ σ' ns κs nt, Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗ ⌜ψ w.val σ'⌝ }}
                            ) →
                    ∀ (n : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
                      (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
                          CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) σ₀ ≠
                            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) σ₀ ≠
                            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
                          ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
                            CerberusHeapLang.driveU M aids n (M.thread e₀ (ev00 :: evs0)) σ₀ =
                                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
                              ψ v σ'
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.engine_complete_caseU :
∀ (M : CerberusHeapLang.MachineCtx) (aid : Nat) {b : List annot} {cval : value}
  {pats : List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr)},
  CerberusHeapLang.esize (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats) ≤
      lemDefaultFuel →
    ∀ (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
      ∃ o,
        CerberusHeapLang.outcomesU M aid (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats)
              ρ σ =
            [o] ∧
          CerberusHeapLang.EngineMatchU M
            (CerberusHeapLang.caseRedex (Pexpr b () (PEval cval)) pats) ρ σ o

def CerberusHeapLang.esize :
CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Nat
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.esize.eq_def :
∀ (x : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.esize x =
    match x with
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq a_1 e1 e2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.esize e1) (CerberusHeapLang.esize e2)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq a_1 e1 e2) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.esize e1) (CerberusHeapLang.esize e2)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot a_1 b) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esize b
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eif a_1 e2 e3) =>
      1 + max (CerberusHeapLang.esize e2) (CerberusHeapLang.esize e3)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esave a_1 a_2 body) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esize body
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ecase a_1 pats) => 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esizeAlts pats
    | x => 1
----

List (pattern × CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr) → Nat

  CerberusHeapLang.esize (generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot ds b)) = 1 + CerberusHeapLang.esize b

theorem CerberusHeapLang.eval1_bridge :
∀ {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {th : thread_state}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext th.env pe = some v →
    CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (σ : CerbMem.MemState) (file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation) (rs : core_run_state),
        stExceptUndef_bind (E.eval_pexpr20 tds th ext σ file pe)
            (fun x =>
              match (motive :=
                pexpr ⊕ value → core_run_state → exceptM (t0 pexpr × core_run_state) core_run_cause)
                x with
              | Sum.inl pe' => stExceptUndef_return pe'
              | Sum.inr cval => stExceptUndef_return (mk_value_pe cval))
            rs =
          Result (Defined (mk_value_pe v), rs)

def CerberusHeapLang.evalBinop :
binop → value → value → Option value
----
def CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  Fmap sym sym → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → generic_pexpr Unit sym → Option value
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr.eq_def :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (x : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ x =
    match x with
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v) => some v
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x) => lookup_env (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x) ρ
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) => do
      let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
      let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
      CerberusHeapLang.evalBinop op v1 v2
    | Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) => do
      let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
      let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
      CerberusHeapLang.evalArrayShift tds ty v1 v2
    | x => none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr.induct :
∀ (motive : generic_pexpr Unit sym → Prop),
  (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (v : value), motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v))) →
    (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (x : sym), motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x))) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
          motive pe1 → motive pe2 → motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2))) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ty : ctype)
            (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
            motive pe1 → motive pe2 → motive (Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2))) →
          (∀ (t : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
              (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (v : value), t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEval v) → False) →
                (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (x : sym), t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEsym x) → False) →
                  (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                      t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEop op pe1 pe2) → False) →
                    (∀ (a : List annot) (a_1 : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ty : ctype)
                        (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
                        t = Pexpr a a_1 (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) → False) →
                      motive t) →
            ∀ (a : generic_pexpr Unit sym), motive a
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_array_shift :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  (ty : ctype) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (Pexpr a () (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2)) = do
    let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
    let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
    CerberusHeapLang.evalArrayShift tds ty v1 v2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_none_of_shape :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (v : value), pe = Pexpr a u (PEval v) → False) →
    (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (x : sym), pe = Pexpr a u (PEsym x) → False) →
      (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
          pe = Pexpr a u (PEop op pe1 pe2) → False) →
        (∀ (a : List annot) (u : Unit) (pe1 : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (ty : ctype)
            (pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe = Pexpr a u (PEarray_shift pe1 ty pe2) → False) →
          CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = none
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_of_valueFromPexpr :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  valueFromPexpr pe = some v → CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = some v
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_op :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  (op : binop) (pe1 pe2 : generic_pexpr Unit sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (Pexpr a () (PEop op pe1 pe2)) = do
    let v1 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe1
    let v2 ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe2
    CerberusHeapLang.evalBinop op v1 v2
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_peStrip :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (CerberusHeapLang.peStrip pe) =
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_shape :
∀ {tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap} {ext : Fmap sym sym} {ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack}
  {pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym} {v : value},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe = some v → CerberusHeapLang.PePure pe
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_sym :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  (x : sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (Pexpr a () (PEsym x)) =
    lookup_env (CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x) ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_sym_empty :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot) (x : sym),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds fmapEmpty ρ (Pexpr a () (PEsym x)) = lookup_env x ρ
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_sym_of_resolve :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {ext : Fmap sym sym} (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  {x : sym},
  CerberusHeapLang.resolveExtern ext x = x →
    CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (Pexpr a () (PEsym x)) = lookup_env x ρ

theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr_val :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (a : List annot)
  (v : value), CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ (Pexpr a () (PEval v)) = some v

def CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs :
CerbTags.TagDefsMap →
  Fmap sym sym → CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack → List (generic_pexpr Unit sym) → Option (List value)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs_cons :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)),
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext ρ (pe :: pes) = do
    let v ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexpr tds ext ρ pe
    let vs ← CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext ρ pes
    pure (v :: vs)

theorem CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs_length :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) (ext : Fmap sym sym) (ρ : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack)
  {pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)} {vs : List value},
  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext ρ pes = some vs → pes.length = vs.length

  CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext ρ [] = some []

theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_engine :
∀ (n : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
  (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
      CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progA) CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ ≠
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
    CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progA) CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ ≠
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
      ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
              (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progA) CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ =
            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
          v = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_prod :
∀ (sup : Nat) (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
  ∃ dres dst',
    CerbND.runND (drive fmapEmpty false (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile CerberusHeapLang.progAProd) args)
          (initial_driver_state sup (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile CerberusHeapLang.progAProd) fs).fst =
        [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
      dres.dres_core_value = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal ∧
        (∃ i a,
            CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh fmapEmpty dst'.layout_state i
              { addr := a, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy,
                bytes := CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes fmapEmpty }) ∧
          dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_semantic :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF],
  CerberusHeapLang.SemTripleU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv
    CerberusHeapLang.progA CerberusHeapLang.mA fun v Q =>
    v = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal ∧ Q = CerberusHeapLang.mA7
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitA_total :
∀ (aids : Nat → Nat),
  ∃ v σ',
    CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids 6
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx.thread CerberusHeapLang.progA CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv)
          CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ =
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' ∧
      v = CerberusHeapLang.sevenVal ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.CellCoh CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx.tagDefs σ' 0
          { addr := CerberusHeapLang.xAddr, ty := CerberusHeapLang.intTy,
            bytes := CerberusHeapLang.sevenBytes CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx.tagDefs }
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitB_engine :
∀ (n : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
  (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
      CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progB) CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ ≠
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
    CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
          (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progB) CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ ≠
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
      ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
        CerberusHeapLang.driveU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx aids n
              (CerberusHeapLang.spikeThread CerberusHeapLang.progB) CerberusHeapLang.σ₀ =
            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
          v = Vunit ∧
            CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ' CerberusHeapLang.xAddr 4 =
                (CerbMem.memValueToBytes fmapEmpty [] CerberusHeapLang.sevenMval).snd ∧
              CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ' CerberusHeapLang.yAddr 4 = CerberusHeapLang.bytesY
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitB_semantic :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGpreS GF],
  CerberusHeapLang.SemTripleU CerberusHeapLang.spikeCtx CerberusHeapLang.spikeEnv
    CerberusHeapLang.progB (Iris.Std.PartialMap.union CerberusHeapLang.mA CerberusHeapLang.mF)
    fun v Q =>
    ∃ Q₀,
      (v = Vunit ∧ Q₀ = CerberusHeapLang.mA7) ∧
        Iris.Std.PartialMap.disjoint Q₀ CerberusHeapLang.mF ∧
          Q = Iris.Std.PartialMap.union Q₀ CerberusHeapLang.mF
----

            CerbMem.readBytesFrom σ' CerberusHeapLang.yAddr 4 = CerberusHeapLang.sixBytes fmapEmpty
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.exhibitC_semantic :

theorem CerberusHeapLang.exists_consequence :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  {mm : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerberusHeapLang.MetaCell}
  {mb : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeHeapF CerbMem.AbsByte} {α : Type u_1} {Φ : α → Iris.IProp GF}
  {ψ : α → Prop},
  (∀ (a : α), Φ a ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜ψ a⌝) →
    (∃ a, Φ a) ∗ CerberusHeapLang.metaInterp mm ∗ CerberusHeapLang.byteInterp mb ⊢ ⌜∃ a, ψ a⌝

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_body_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs) (CerberusHeapLang.fibLs n)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibPost n) (CerberusHeapLang.fibBody ra n)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec i.toNat))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (i.toNat + 1))) f ::
                  rest)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_body_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    ∀ (i : Int) (f : Fmap sym value) (rest : List (Fmap sym value)),
      CerberusHeapLang.SymFrame f →
        0 ≤ i →
          i ≤ n →
            ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs) (CerberusHeapLang.fibLsT n)
                (2 * (n - i).toNat + 3) (CerberusHeapLang.fibPost n) (CerberusHeapLang.fibBody ra n)
                (CerberusHeapLang.fibFrame (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal i)
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec i.toNat))
                    (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec (i.toNat + 1))) f ::
                  rest)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_certified :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (ibty abty bbty sbty : core_base_type) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (nsteps : Nat) (aids : Nat → Nat),
      have prog := CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty;
      have rs := CerberusHeapLang.fibRS ra n ibty abty bbty;
      (∀ (r : kill_reason mem_error),
          CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym rs) aids
              nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) σ₀ ≠
            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.killed r) ∧
        CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym rs) aids
              nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym prog [fmapEmpty]) σ₀ ≠
            CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.stuck ∧
          ∀ (v : value) (σ' : CerberusHeapLang.Mem),
            CerberusHeapLang.driveU (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym rs) aids
                  nsteps (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym prog [fmapEmpty])
                  σ₀ =
                CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done v σ' →
              v = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_certified_production :
∀ (sup : Nat) (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (sbty ibty abty bbty : core_base_type),
  0 ≤ n →
    2 * n.toNat + 6 ≤ lemDefaultFuel →
      ∀ (fs : CerbFS.FsState) (args : List String),
        ∃ dres dst',
          CerbND.runND
                (drive fmapEmpty false
                  (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile (CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty))
                  args)
                (initial_driver_state sup
                    (CerberusHeapLang.prodFile (CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty))
                    fs).fst =
              [(Active dres, [], dst')] ∧
            dres.dres_core_value = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat) ∧
              dres.dres_blocked = false ∧ dres.dres_stdout = "" ∧ dres.dres_stderr = ""
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_certified_total :
∀ (ra : core_run_annotation) (ibty abty bbty sbty : core_base_type) (n : Int),
  0 ≤ n →
    ∀ (σ₀ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem) (aids : Nat → Nat),
      CerberusHeapLang.driveU
          (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym
            (CerberusHeapLang.fibRS ra n ibty abty bbty))
          aids (2 * n.toNat + 4)
          (CerberusHeapLang.procThread CerberusHeapLang.fibProcSym
            (CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty) [fmapEmpty])
          σ₀ =
        CerberusHeapLang.DriveResult.done
          (CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)) σ₀
----

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_wp_readout :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    0 ≤ n →
      ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
        ⊢
          WP
            { e := CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty, ρ := [fmapEmpty],
              M := CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs } @
            Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck ;
            ⊤ {{
              w,
                ∀ σ' ns κs nt,
                  Iris.stateInterp σ' ns κs nt ={⊤,∅}=∗
                    ⌜w.val = CerberusHeapLang.ivVal (CerberusHeapLang.fibSpec n.toNat)⌝ }}

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_wps :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    0 ≤ n →
      ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
        ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wps (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs) (CerberusHeapLang.fibLs n)
            (CerberusHeapLang.fibPost n) (CerberusHeapLang.fibProg ra n sbty ibty abty bbty)
            [fmapEmpty]

theorem CerberusHeapLang.fib_wpt :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (ra : core_run_annotation) (n : Int) (ibty abty bbty : core_base_type) (p : sym)
  (rs : core_run_state),
  CerberusHeapLang.LabeledAt rs p (CerberusHeapLang.fibQ ra n ibty abty bbty) →
    0 ≤ n →
      ∀ (sbty : core_base_type),
        ⊢
          CerberusHeapLang.wpt (CerberusHeapLang.procCtx p rs) (CerberusHeapLang.fibLsT n)
            (2 * n.toNat + 4) (CerberusHeapLang.fibPost n)

          dres_driver_steps := dst.dr_step_counter, dres_core_value := v,

theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldM_args_bridge :
∀ {th : thread_state} {tds : Fmap sym (CerbLocation.Loc × tag_definition)}
  {σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem} {file : generic_file Unit core_run_annotation} {ext : Fmap sym sym}
  (f :
    CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack →
      (sym × core_base_type) × generic_pexpr Unit sym →
        core_run_state → exceptM (t0 CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack × core_run_state) core_run_cause),
  (∀ (acc : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (s : sym) (bTy : core_base_type)
      (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym) (rs' : core_run_state),
      f acc ((s, bTy), pe) rs' =
        stExceptUndef_bind (full_eval_pexpr tds th ext σ file pe)
          (fun cval => stExceptUndef_return (update_env (mk_sym_pat s bTy) cval acc)) rs') →
    ∀ (params : List (sym × core_base_type)) (pes : List (generic_pexpr Unit sym)) (vs : List value)
      (acc : CerberusHeapLang.EnvStack) (rs : core_run_state),
      CerberusHeapLang.evalPexprs tds ext th.env pes = some vs →
        (∀ (pe : generic_pexpr Unit sym), pe ∈ pes → CerberusHeapLang.peDepth pe ≤ lemDefaultFuel) →
          stExceptUndef_foldM f acc (params.zip pes) rs =
            Result (Defined (CerberusHeapLang.bindArgs params vs acc), rs)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldl_append_singletons_length :
∀ {α β : Type} (g : α → List β) (bs : List α) (init : List β),
  (∀ (p : α), p ∈ bs → (g p).length = 1) →
    (List.foldl (fun acc p => g p ++ acc) init bs).length = init.length + bs.length

theorem CerberusHeapLang.foldl_update_env_cons :
∀ {α : Type} (f : α → pattern) (g : α → value) (xs : List α) (ev0 : Fmap sym value)
  (evs : List (Fmap sym value)),
  ∃ ev0', List.foldl (fun acc a => update_env (f a) (g a) acc) (ev0 :: evs) xs = ev0' :: evs

    if a ≤ k ∧ k < a + ↑bs.length then bs[(k - a).toNat]? else Iris.Std.get? m k

def CerberusHeapLang.isList :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] → CerbMem.PointerValue → List (Int × Int) → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_cons :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (nd : Int × Int) (ns : List (Int × Int)),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p (nd :: ns) =
    iprop(∃ aN q bs,
        ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr nd.fst aN ∧
              0 < aN ∧
                aN < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                  bs.length = 16 ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs nd.snd ∧
                      CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec fmapEmpty bs q⌝ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty nd.fst (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
              { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.isList q ns)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_cons_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id aN : Int) (q : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (v : Int)
  (ns : List (Int × Int)),
  0 < aN →
    aN < 2 ^ 64 →
      bs.length = 16 →
        CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs v →
          CerberusHeapLang.nodeNextDec fmapEmpty bs q →
            CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                  { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.nodeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
                CerberusHeapLang.isList q ns ⊢
              CerberusHeapLang.isList (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN) ((id, v) :: ns)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_nil :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue), CerberusHeapLang.isList p [] = iprop(⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullNode⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_nil_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF],
  ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.isList CerberusHeapLang.nullNode []
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_shape :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (ws : List (Int × Int)),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p ws ⊢
    ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullNode ∨
          ∃ id aN, p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧ 0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.isList p ws
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isList_to_cells :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (ws : List (Int × Int)) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.isList p ws ⊢
    ∃ m,
      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SeedChain m p ws⌝ ∗
        [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c
----
def CerberusHeapLang.isTree :
{hlc : Iris.HasLC} →
  {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} →
    [CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF] →
      CerbMem.PointerValue → CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree → Iris.IProp GF
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_leaf :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.leaf = iprop(⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullTree⌝)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_leaf_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF],
  ⊢ CerberusHeapLang.isTree CerberusHeapLang.nullTree CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.leaf
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_node :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (id v : Int) (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r) =
    iprop(∃ aN ql qr bs,
        ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧
              0 < aN ∧
                aN < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                  bs.length = 24 ∧
                    CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs v ∧
                      CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 8 ql ∧
                        CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 16 qr⌝ ∗
          CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
              { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.treeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
            CerberusHeapLang.isTree ql l ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isTree qr r)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_node_intro :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (id aN : Int) (ql qr : CerbMem.PointerValue) (bs : List CerbMem.AbsByte) (v : Int)
  (l r : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  0 < aN →
    aN < 2 ^ 64 →
      bs.length = 24 →
        CerberusHeapLang.nodeValDec fmapEmpty bs v →
          CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 8 ql →
            CerberusHeapLang.treePtrDec fmapEmpty bs 16 qr →
              CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty id (Iris.DFrac.own 1)
                    { addr := aN, ty := CerberusHeapLang.treeTy, bytes := bs } ∗
                  CerberusHeapLang.isTree ql l ∗ CerberusHeapLang.isTree qr r ⊢
                CerberusHeapLang.isTree (CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN)
                  (CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree.node id v l r)
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_shape :
∀ {hlc : Iris.HasLC} {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS hlc GF]
  (p : CerbMem.PointerValue) (t : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p t ⊢
    ⌜p = CerberusHeapLang.nullTree ∨
          ∃ id aN, p = CerberusHeapLang.cellPtr id aN ∧ 0 < aN ∧ aN < 2 ^ 64⌝ ∗
      CerberusHeapLang.isTree p t

theorem CerberusHeapLang.isTree_to_cells :
∀ {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors} [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF]
  (t : CerberusHeapLang.NodeTree) (p : CerbMem.PointerValue),
  CerberusHeapLang.isTree p t ⊢
    ∃ m,
      ⌜CerberusHeapLang.SeedTree m p t⌝ ∗
        [∗map] i ↦ c ∈ m, CerberusHeapLang.cellOwn fmapEmpty i (Iris.DFrac.own 1) c

def CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? :
CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr → Option (sym × List (generic_pexpr Unit sym))
----
theorem CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex?.eq_def :
∀ (x : CerberusHeapLang.CoreExpr),
  CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? x =
    match x with
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Erun a_1 l pes) => some (l, pes)
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Esseq a_1 e1 a_2) => CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Ewseq a_1 e1 a_2) => CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? e1
    | generic_expr.Expr a (Eannot a_1 b) =>
      if CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true then none else CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b
    | x => none
----

    if CerberusHeapLang.annotRooted b = true then none else CerberusHeapLang.jumpRedex? b

theorem CerberusHeapLang.launchResources :
∀ (tds : CerbTags.TagDefsMap) {GF : Iris.BundledGFunctors}
  [inst : CerberusHeapLang.SpikeGS Iris.HasLC.hasLC GF] (σ : CerberusHeapLang.Mem)

        (Iris.stateInterp σ 0 [] 0 ∗

            CerberusHeapLang.allocCap tds reqs)
